I really love this trouser. ordered online and they fit well. they're cute, edgy with the fray at the bottom. corduroy material. awesome!
I was worried this sweater would be too tight, but it has a very flattering fit. i am a librarian and this sweater makes me feel like a quirky librarian. i love it!

I'm on the shorter (5''3") side of the spectrum and usually wear an xs in retailer. this is a lovely suit but it didn't work at all for me. it might work well on a taller person or someone who is longer waisted. the ruching and fuller cut leg was not flattering on me at all. it was very tight and pinched. sadly, i returned it.

I loved this clothe the minute i tried it on and am actually really sad that i had to return it. however, the embroidery was unraveling in several places before i'd even worn it, so i thought it would probably only get worse. too bad because it's gorgeous and flattering!

I love the colors in this clothe, it's very feminine. however, i wish it came in petite because even the xs is too overwhelming on my frame.

Sweater clothees are my fall/winter uniform and the patterns on this one are particularly unique and lovely. i'm 5'2'' with a small bust, this fit nicely and moves well, it's not baggy or bulky and not tight. good for work and play. i would usually wait to see if an item at this price goes on sale, but this one is the kind of piece that i expect to be snapped up swiftly and i don't regret getting it at full price.

Such a beautiful pattern - i think you could wear it with a skirt and it wouldn't even read as a bathing suit. love the lacy pattern in front. magnificent fit. i bought a medium, when i usually wear a small in retailer. it fits a little loose, so i'd probably buy a small if i bought another one, but it all depends on how you like your suits to fit.

This is so pretty! it was beautiful in white but i bought the blue because the fabric is a little bit see through. i'm 5' 4" and weigh about 135 and this shirt fit just like on the model in the picture. it was a nice neat loose. not sloppy at all.
I love these jeans, but they run small. i recommend ordering one size up.

This is a gorgeous blouse. the quality is on point. i was so disappointed because i had to return it.
the blouse was just a few inches too tight across the bust.

Love this clothe. i have it in white. just washed it in cold water in the machine and it still looks like new. very cute and comfortable. i stitched up the slit a bit, i am older, but otherwise, excellent.

This might be one of my new go to tops. looks cute with jeans and a sweater or alone. the arms are snug but not uncomfortable and i think it adds to the shirt.

Thee are beautiful trousers. so soft to the touch. true to color. ca.t wait to wear them in the fall.

This clothe is super cute, flattering and well made but it runs very small. i am usually a 6 so from other reviews i ordered an 8 and it is still tight in the hip area. it zips but the fabric pulls a bit in the front and it rides up when i walk. i am going to try and exchange it for a 10 because i think i'll get lots of wear out of it.

Love the colors and design of this lace-printed top but didn't realize it's not lined. the description says its polyester lace with polyester lining so i assumed it was lined and when you look at the photos, there is a lining under the top. the arm holes are slightly cut-in both front and back so it will be rather difficult to find a camisole with thin straps with a similar cut so they don't show. other than that, it's a beautiful, unique summer top.

I wasn't sure how clingy this clothe might be or how it would look on my "curvy" body. it's actually really lovely. it runs large but not overwhelming. nice length; above the knee in the front, slightly longer in the back. the colors are really beautiful (i got the darker color). will definitely wear this with a belt, otherwise i think (as other reviewers said) it will be too maternity-looking. i got this at a magnificent sale price!
This top is very pretty. it's a bit more voluminous than the picture would let on, but otherwise as expected. you can adjust the ties at the shoulder.

This sweater is very cute! it looks magnificent with a blouse underneath and open the zipper or it is magnificent with a camisole. you will need something underneath especially if the temperatures are low as it is a wee bit shear. i am a small/medium ordinarily but it depends upon the designer. this runs a little large but keep that in mind if you plan on layering. the price is right and the zipper is aesthetically pleasing. i have the blue and oatmeal/beige color both are magnificent pieces to any wardrobe.

I paired this gorgeous top with a black v-neck cardigan, mother lookers and black booties and felt and looked so totally feminine and amazing...i honestly lost count of the compliments that i received!!  beading is sewn on tightly, and the stitching on the embroidery has no loose ends.  i am 5'3"/108 and took the regular size small.  highly recommend!!

I ordered this on a whim during the 40% discount upon sale price. i was a bit worried it looked like a burlap sack initially, but after trying it on with an under tank and leggings i decided it was a keeper. its quite soft and is flattering. i usually wear a medium, got the m/l and fits well.
This is so bulky and itchy...could not stand to have it on! i'm a 6/8 & ordered the small, but it was still gigantic.

This super cute skirt has a beautiful drape and overall fit. i was afraid the tie at the front would emphasize my slight tummy, but to the contrary, the skirt is flattering and slimming. at 5'3", the front of the skirt hits at my upper to mid knee. 118 lbs., 26" waist, 36" hips, size 2 regular is a excellent fit.

This is exactly as pictured, and fits as it does on the model in the last picture. my only hang-up is that it's a little pricey for a t-shirt, the fabric is standard t-shirt material, not stiff but also not super soft which i was hoping for. my hubby had no idea what the pattern was til i pointed it out :)

Review_Title: Cute, unique t shirt. magnificent with jeans!

the combination of fabrics is what makes this top special and the sheer bell sleeve really sets it off. 
i felt that it flowed excellently, not as full as some of the fall retailer tops. (which are too full for me.)
i am around 5'6" and a little on the broad side, so perhaps on someone smaller it might be overbeari

I really wanted these jeans to work but i am too curvy and not tall enough for them. i just felt like they were swallowing me up with fabric. i am 5'5" and had a stacked boot heel on when i tried them on and they were still too long. i felt like they made me look even bigger than i am. the fabric is nice, not as dark as the photo as others have said.

When i spotted this online i just knew it was a 'must have'. holding horses brand usually runs big on me, but this is a more fitted top. i ordered the size 4 & 6 so i cld compare. well, the 4 is a little snug in the bust area & the bodice seam falls high across the mid-bust area. except for that the fit is good. being cotton i realize it will probably shrink some when washed so i don't think the 4 works for me. the size 6 is much looser overall & the fit is much better in the bust area. the armh
If they still have your size, grab it. fits a bit snug in chest, but material is light and airy. got so many compliments on it. magnificent style

This top is the excellent combo of function and flair! the style of the top makes it easy to wear and the back detail is just lovely. i love that it can be worn as either a buttoned-up top or a light over-shirt with a t-shirt or camisole underneath. i would pair this with blue or gray skinny jeans.

Possibly my preferred retailer purchase ever! like wearing a cloud & fit excellently! if you're busty - not sure about it -- but otherwise wow! told my husband: hope you like it because you'll be seeing it all the time & he not only agreed but wanted to know if they made pajamas for men.

Love these trousers. it's hard to get really dark dark black jeans with a little stretch, and these are excellent. i also like the cut as a bit of a change from skin tight leggings. and the fabric is super cool, like a lightweight brocade denim. i get compliments every time i wear them.

I'm 5'5", 115 lbs, with a 25" waist and 35" hips. i purchased a 25 and the fit was excellent. i'm just a bit short waisted, have a rather small waist and often find that trousers of any kind gap at the back. these fit excellently, felt magnificent on, and i love the fabric.
Really cute and comfortable. i can wear it to work for a casual friday, or out on the weekend. a lot of the sequins are falling off and getting stuck in my dryer!

I bought this in the green and i had to try a few to get one that sat well- in fact i tried on a size above my normal size and that particular clothe was shorter and tighter than my normal size. when i reordered my normal size, it was a pretty good fit. i kept the clothe but am still on the fence on whether or not i should actually keep it- it took so long to find one that fit well that it missed the holiday events where i'd hoped to wear it.

This clothe is my new best friend. i've been looking for work clothees that don't require much effort in putting together an outfit, and this is just it! the pattern is fun and unique (i got many compliments), the cut is comfortable, flattering and feminine. the clothe really speaks for itself, and all i have to do is throw it on and run out the door. the only negative is there was a loose piece of thread at the bottom (fingers crossed this doesn't lead to problems later on) and the sleeve buttons

You know how you hope that a clothe that you order online is as good as you think it will be? well, this one is better then i had hoped! it fits beautifully. it is crafted beautifully. there is nothing i don't like about it. i was pleasantly surprised at how light the fabric is. i thought it might be a heavier denim, but it is excellent. not so light that you can see through it, but cool and breezy even in the florida heat. do yourself a favor and grab this one before it's gone!

I had my eye on this clothe for months. i came into some extra cash and bought it at full price online and picked it up in the store. the purple pattern is nowhere near as soft as pictures. it was very bright which disappointed me. it's also made for more busty women. at a 34d i could in no way fill this clothe out. the result made it look so frumpy and unflattering. i felt like an old lady in a bag.

Bought this top on a whim on a tops sale and am really glad i did. it's a nice two-in-one piece that can be clotheed up for the office with a blazer or down with jeans and a sweater. striped portion of the shirt is a ponte stretchy material. i am 5'5", 135lbs, 34c, curvy/muscular frame and the small was excellent and even roomy (i don't like things too tight).
Magnificent piece just wish it fit a bit more blousy rather than cami
This clothe fits beautifully. it is warm and comfortable. winter's gem.

I had high hopes for this tunic for an upcoming ny trip - to look stylish and beat the heat. it is huge. the tunic swallowed my whole. it came down nearly to my knees (i'm 5' 6) and it was gigantic - shapeless and did not look stylish at all. on the model it looks like it hits mid-thigh. i am a size 10 - and the l was like a giant trash bag on me. if i had time, i would try the medium,...

Review_Title: Cute clothe but courderoy is too heavy feeling
Review: The pattern is cute and vibrant, and the shillouette is simple, but the courderoy felt too heavy and stiff and it was too small around the chest for me (36dd).

I'm not nearly as tall as the model so these hit right just right for flats. i love the fit of the wide leg and found the color matching the photo and the light color cords very soft. i did try the blue color on at a different store and found them a bit short. i'm really pleased with these and the sale on sale certainly helped.

This clothe is really cute and is a lightweight knit that is magnificent for warmer days. the color is a lovely dusty rose that looks just like the picture. since it is a knit material and does tend to stretch out, i did go down one size so that it would be more form fitting. the length on the petite size is excellent for me.

This little number is really cute, i got it on sale, after i looked at it, went home, slept and decided i had to go ack for it:-0
i will wear it with trouser jeans and a blazer for work, or jsut jeans and boots for casual wear.

I was thrilled when this shirt arrived.  it is as cute in person as in the catalog.  it's soft, it fit excellent, and it looks magnificent with shorts and trousers.  it will be my "go to" shirt this summer.
Huge! normally wear a medium and this was huge and very unflattering.

First i found the picture of this blouse stunning because the colors caught my attention . with that said, i found myself thinking of all the many events this could worn to, clotheed up or down. so.... i found myself ordering it asap, paranoid that others were thinking i was thinking the same thing. well , i received it in the mail , and it was better than i thought!!! the colors and cut of this blouse is just as in the picture. i personally love this article/pattern of art, as i see it as an exp
I love this sweater combo! as a larger woman, i am always looking for flattering tops. the draping in front covers all the right areas! i wish they made them in more colors!

Magnificent material that drapes nicely. super comfy, feels cool but it's a thick material--not at all see through. so happy i purchased this. and super easy with the snap buttons, but the shirt is very well made and high-quality material. would look magnificent on all sizes and shapes. i'm 5' 4" and about 140, small chest. normally i'm a s or m with tops but bought this in a m because i like a slightly oversized shirt, though it's also made to be looser and longer. still, at 5' 4" i'm not swimming in a m.

Loose fitting and comfortable without losing its shape. 
looks magnificent on. the tie in front adds to the clothe. 

i love to wear with tan knee-high boots.

I found this at my local store and ended up buying both colors. the fabric is thicker than a t-shirt. these will go with so many things....jeans to clothey skirts. i normally wear a small but ended up buying the medium (2). the small fit me but was a little too short (for reference i am 5'8"). these will be a staple in my wardrobe all year round. love!
This is a very nice, flattering thing which can be worn as a clothe or a shirt. therefore decided tiokeep it.
Like it; but it's quite short and rather boxy. i'll keep it because it's pretty versatile.

Gorgeous clothe with a slimming pattern and flattering waistband. i would say the bust cups are a little floppy on the medium petite and i have 36dds. like others, i wish the skirt was lined but it's not a deal breaker. tracy reese did a magnificent job creating movement in the skirt and flounce without the bulk. i can wear a little heel but wearing flats makes the hem drag.

This is a beautiful knit clothe, however it runs large, so be wary. for reference i am a 34d, 28 inch waist, and 41 inch hips. i ordered a medium because clothees usually run tight around my bum, and it was very, very big. i'm hoping the small is much more flattering because the quality of the knit is very nice.

I love the cold shoulder trend, and this top seemed to satisfy. i bought it in the blue, which is really more like a very light mint green. however, i think the material is pretty thin (though soft), and the keyhole sleeve area, right by the twist, is not substantial so it looks a little cheap. i ordered the small, but i think i could have definitely sized down to the xs (110 pounds, 32dd). it's very loose fitting but i wouldn't say it looks bad. it's just a very relaxed fit. for the price, thou

I love this top! although it is a tad big, i expected this because the moth brand usually does run a tad big. however, i am still able to wear it without any nerves that it's too big.... hope that makes sense! the navy was more lovely with my skin + hair, but the yellow was so pretty too!

I ordered this in the "plum" color, which in real life just looks like a very, very dark brown. that would probably be okay, but the clothe is actually about 3 inches shorter than the listed measurements. i ordered the regular length, but the shortest part of the hem hits me only about halfway down my thigh...way, way too short. i am 5'5", for reference. lastly, i think the fabric is just awful quality, especially for this price point. the slight texture makes it want to cling to itself - worn ou

I was so excited to get this in the mail... and loved everything about it except for the fact that it was only as long as one inch above my navel! i don't know why it looks like a normal length on the model. im returning it.

I got the coat in the gray. it's a pretty pretty shade of gray. it's soft and feels really good on. it's short. like hits at the waist. i have long arms and the small for excellent which i was very pleased.
Cute everyday shorts. run tts to maybe just slightly small. not too short for this mid 30s mom.

I had to keep rechecking the price tag on this one to be sure i saw it correctly. price aside though, it's really awesome. fit is flattering, stripes are cute, colors are nice, and you can wear it all summer long. if you can get over the dollar signs, it's a keeper!

Review_Title: Nice mix of romantic and practical
Review: I have a long list of criteria for this sort of a top. the lace can't be too fragile, the top can't be too see through, it can't bind my arms in an uncomfortable way and it can't be dry clean only. the stars have aligned on this one! i bought my usual size 2 and it fits tts. i only wish it was a little longer but i will probably wear it layered with a long cami. it certainly seems worth it for full price.

I loved the style when i saw it online and even more in person. the fabric is light but not too light. it has a nice drape i didn't expect. easy to wear and style. the draw string gives it a magnificent shape but a belt is a magnificent addition for more interest. the length is fantastic as well. wonderful midi length but with the side slits.
This shirt is like the best worn in flannel with a little feminine flair! super soft and magnificent length.
This is the 4th pair of current/elliot jeans i've bought.  i'm 5'4 so the length is excellent for flats.  they are so soft and cozy. wish they had a design on the pockets but love them none the less!
This is a stunning clothe. fits true to size, very high quality, has a very flattering shape, and the lace embroidery is gorgeous.
Magnificent clothe! i ordered the extra small petite and it fits excellently!

This clothe makes my heart skip a beat. it's beautiful, soft and colorful. it's a lovely midi length which can be tricky for 5'5" lil ole me but it's excellent. it has slits up the side for an easy breezy look. the fabric is so silky & pretty form fitting if you buy the right size. i'm a solid 4. have bought heaps of clothees from retailer and i can't stop, won't stop.
Cute but classy top because of the embroidery at the bottom!
Love this clothe! the neckline is gorgeous

I wanted to love this product so badly. i ordered it in the mail, and it looked beautiful coming out of the box. i normally look really nice in grey, but this color really washed me out and was not nice on. the fabric is very sheer, so you would have to wear it over a camisole/tank top. this is one of those pieces that looks better on the hanger than in person. large in arms, small on body. odd fit.

Picked this up on sale - was on the fence about the bright reddish/orange coloration, but it really says summer and goes so easily with multiple summer pieces. it is generously cut and made very well. i've worn it on cooler/rainy days and it really brightens everything up. best part is that it launders well too.
I really liked the design. ordered a medium which was huge. also thought i would not be able to tolerate it because of the material -- a bit itchy. returned it.
Cute fit but... split in the thigh after two weeks. and i'm not a big gal. poor quality.

It is gorgeous, and yes, the side slits are very high, but i am still keeping and rocking it. i am a size 10-12 and got the large, probably could have got the medium, but after a few washings, i think the larger size will be ok. side slits high, but if the weather is good, and you have self tanner on legs, it looks magnificent with shortie boots. i have gotten many cmpliments on it, just hope it still keeps its shape after a long day of wear. very pretty in cream, though, i do recommend it. i am 5'8,
The print is unique and fun. however, the longer length and heavier weight of the fabric was not the piece i needed in my closet.
This has lovely embroidery of good quality, and it is nicely lined in the embroidered section too. it is a very loose swingy shape, so size down.

I wasn't expecting to love to this clothe as much as i do.  the length and horizontal stripes (petite was sold out and my torso is square) are automatically two strikes but the sale-on-sale price was begging me to give it a go.  so glad i did!  the cut and flare are flattering.  the self to tie is slimming and can be styled different ways.  the regular length is doable when i wear platform wedges.  the colors scream summer and vacation fun.  my only problem is the feel of the fabric--liner is fin

This is cut very strangely, i'm short waisted and this barely covered my belly button. the material is rough and scratchy. did not like at all and will be returning.

This clothe really was huge, and not at all flattering. i don't know how they got it to look good on the model in the picture. material was nice and soft, but i really don't see how anyone could look good in this, no matter what your body shape is.

I tried this in the black and white in the store. the material is very thin. you cannot wear the white without a cami which defeats the purpose of wearing this tank in the summery. the arm holes are cut very inconsistently. some are very big which creates a very unflattering gap under the armpit. others are cut fine. i tried on 3 different smalls in the black and found one that was cut just right. this does fit snuggly, but is more flattering that way.
I bought the red and it is gorgeous. i love how it hangs - heavy but fluid. i usually wear a 4 but i bought a 6 and it was excellent.
The colors on this sweater are cute, the fabric is good quality and not too thick for spring. the fit is tts.

Review_Title: This clothe is excellent for summer!
Review: This clothe was love at first sight.  i did have to size down from my normal size but the clothe is so comfortable and cool.  as another reviewer said, it does shrink after first wash but excellent now since i am 5'2".  it shrank about one inch in length only.  i got many compliments and my husband said it was beautiful- that's a plus! i was comfortable and cool all day.  get it before it is out of stock.  this clothe will not make it to sale.
Fits excellent.
Cute tank, runs big. i purchased the mango and it's a bit sheer.
I wore this clothe to work with a tan pair of booties and the compliments started upon entry and did not stop till the end of the day. very feminine and comfy all at once.

There's something special about this tank that makes it uber-flattering. the fabric is excellent, the colors (green and fuchsia) are spot-on gorgeous and brightening, and the cut (length, wide straps, and scooped neckline) make this the excellent staple. it flattered my figure, skin color, and really hid my flaws. i wish i could get away with wearing this every day...
I ordered a size 0. the clothe was extremely large. i am 5'2 and weigh 110. i guess you really must be 5'9 like the model to wear this clothe. such a shame..

I was attracted to this sweater because of it's unique style. i really love it. it looks just like the picture. it is of good quality, as is the leather belt. it is the excellent fall sweater and i love that it's different. i highly recommend this sweater.
Love this sweater! warm, cozy and and not ordinary!!! fits magnificent too! no surprises!

This clothe has a beautiful fabric, i really hated to send it back. it was just so unflattering, completely no shape to it. i bought a 0p, i'm 5'5" and 117lbs and it looked like a maternity clothe on me.

I adore this clothe.
the fabrics are elegant and unique and combine for a stunning look!
tried with a belt and looks wonderful with or without......so many options.
excellent clothe for warm autumn days!
ordered my usual size and fits very true to size.
a must have!

So stunning, i had to have it for my spring wardrobe! fits true to size and fits well in the bust and is looser on the bottom. the model weara it just as it fits on me. if you have a large bust you may need to size up as the fabric isn't stretchy.

Review_Title: Very pretty - runs large (busty petites rejoice 3)
Review: I kept the size 8 of the clothe and had to return the 10 as it was too roomy at the arms and chest (which is magnificent!!!). material is nice and not too much material, hangs nice (its a swing). another win!
It runs long for a 5'1" woman like me:) other than that beautiful clothe for vacation

I love white for summer and by august i am tired of wearing sleeveless...so this caught my eye. it is very easy to wear and pretty on. i wore it with black tie up shoes and accessories. super comfy & stylish.

Review_Title: Cute leggings for cooler days, but be aware of fit
Review:
I've been wanting to add some cords to my wardrobe and had to give these a try. i ordered the blue color on-line in size 31. i'm somewhat in-between size 30 and 31 in jeans right now, so i thought i'd be on the safe side and go up. i ended up keeping these and i'm happy with my purchase, although i do feel like the cut of the leggings is a bit off for me. i am a proportional hour-glass shape and i found these leggings to be quite snug in the thigh, while being oversized in the waist.
in the end,
These jeans are so comfortable and they are made of the softest fabric. i love that they can be clotheed up or down. love these!!

Review_Title: Received lots of compliments on this clothe!

i have received 6 compliments on this clothe the first day i wore it! it is comfortable, love the colors and design, it is fun. very g

I ordered a size 10 in the neutral motif and it fits excellently and it looks magnificent. i am 5'9" 145lbs with 38" bust. the sleeves are the excellent length. i couldn't be happier with this purchase.

I bought the burgundy color in this shirt clothe. usually wear a size 4 and xs in most brands. purchased the xs in this clothe. i'm 5'4, 118#, 34d. the fabric is rayon however it feels more like a light flannel or soft brushed cotton. like you've worn it forever. the length says 40" long but i found when worn with the belt it rides up substantially. about 2-3 inches above the knee. felt like i was squirming to pull it down. i normally wouldn't be drawn to something so simple but when i walked out

The top itself is beautiful and colors are like pictured. my only issue was the size. i went for medium ( i'm usually m or l) and i'm 5'4" so i can get away with regular and pettite. this top was way too long. looked like clothe on me. i'm sending it back for exchange

First saw this coat in the catalog, in peach, and had to have it. i received it today, and love it. its a soft, muted peach, very neutral. i ordered xl, im usually a m-l, but decided i wanted it to look big and comfy. the quality is magnificent, feels good on. love it so much, i just ordered it in the dark grey. very classic coat, will wear for years. one of my preferred hei hei pieces, never disappoints.

The blazer is boxy and less clothey that it seemed online. i could only really wear this in casual situations, and i was hoping to be able to wear it to work as well. it does have an interesting hemline. the shoulders are a bit too narrow for me (but i do have shoulders on the broader side). i don't hate it, but i don't love it either, but it is interesting enough that i'm going to keep it. i ordered a small.

I got the moss color in this cardigan. i'm not sure why these aren't sold out because it is pretty amazing! it is super soft and is a cute addition to a casual outfit. i would say that for this price it's definitely worth the buy!

I ordered this shirt in the grey/blue color choice; the creamy grey is excellently heathered and the blue silk-like bottom is a classy touch. the fit of this shirt in the arms, torso, and back was flattering with a little room to drape. love it!

This top caught my eye in the store due to the beautiful print and lovely fabric. the photo really doesn't do it justice. i happened to have on a pencil skirt when i tried it on and the top looked magnificent with my skirt though i will probably wear it more often with jeans or trousers. it's a stunner!

This is a pretty sweater that is magnificent for transitioning to fall. wear it sleeveless on throw a leather coat over it for cooler nights. fights true to size. the gray is a very pretty color. magnificent addition to my wardrobe!

I was excited to get this shirt in the mail, i liked the pattern a lot, but was so disappointed when i tried it on. i am 5'4", 130 lbs. and wear a c cup so i tried ordering a small as a starting point. there was enough fabric on the sides to make another shirt! despite the excess fabric, the shirt pulled open in the chest area, making it a complete fail. i'm sure the model in the photo must have the shirt clipped in the back to pull in the excess fabric, especially since she's small on top. ther

Got this today and am really pleased. beautiful detail and i love how the cowl neck hangs. it's not itchy at all. overall, a magnificent find for the colder months ahead. i got a small and probably should have ordered xs  instead. runs a little big on my petite frame.
Cozy, soft fabric.  love the snails on the pockets and the cute buttons.  size down if you want a more tailored fit.

I wear a lot of solid dark colors for work so i liked this was dark blue but had more pop than the simple navy. able to pay it up with other colors too. the sides are a little shorter so have to watch throughout the day so belly isn't showing. not a bid deal overall.

I love this sweater especially the color. i never would have order this sweater on line but when i saw it in person the color was more of a burnt orange. the fit was excellent. i can wear with skinny jeans or leggings.

This clothe fit excellently and as i am a bit curvy the style compliments my figure. it is a bit fuller in the bottom than the photo looks. also, i am 5'4" and it is a right to the bottom of my knees which is also very complimentary.

So soft, high quality, excellent poncho sweater that will go with every pair of jeans you have. love!

Review:

recommendation: order 1 size down from your normal sizing as clothe runs large.
the quality of the knit material is soft and flowing.

Stunning, beautiful, elegant, comfortable and all silk!  the print is very mesmerizing, as are all the hemant & nandita pieces i own.  i'm shocked that there aren't more reviews.  i found this fit excellently on my body, skimming over my flaws and keeping my temperature moderate.  i am 5'3" 140# 39-28-35 and purchased size mp.  please retailer, offer the other versions of this clothe as shown on the uk retailer site.

Love this clothe! ?? i tried it on at the store and loved how it felt on. i put it on hold to think about it and returned later that day to purchase. i am glad i did. the 1st day i wore it i received numerous compliments!

the sleeves are long on me. so you taller girls won't have issues.  the ruffles move and are so fun.  the fabric, however, is not finished off.  it's raw cut material, which is why i gave it 4 stars.

I wore this sweater while gathering ingredients for my thanksgiving feast and 3 different women at whole foods complimented my sweater. it is soft and warm. would love in other colors too...like a mint green.
Runs big and looked unflattering. i am petite, might work on someone taller.
This skirt is so cozy and comfortable. it is form fitting but has a lot of give/stretch. the material feels high quality and heavy without being overly hot. i am sure this will be a go to skirt.
These trousers are fun! i use them as sleep trousers. i had to size up because the waist band was a little tight for comfort.
This clothe is completely fantastic. beautiful, high-quality, and fits like a glove. even better than i could have imagined.
Adorable & comfortable. i'm 5'3", 115 lbs, and ordered an xs.

I just bought this clothe on the half off sale price which is practically a steal and i must say i completely adore it! it runs pretty tts but all they had available was one size up from my usual 6 so i bought the 8 and it fits just fine (34d-27-35). the color is beautiful and the look of the clothe is very vintage 30's/40's and so cute. i didn't find the sleeves to stick out at all on me so maybe i just got lucky and the print is just adorable on this. i highly recommend!

The coral is stunning. the shirt has a slight flare at the bottom that you can't see in the picture, it isn't a straight cut. the sewn edges are rough style making the shirt right for casual wear with jeans, or clotheing down something fancier.

I love this clothe. like another reviewer said, it's the excellent teacher clothe. i wore it on the first day of school. it's comfortable and flattering and super cute. i received lots of compliments.

3. the buttons lay nice and flat over the tummy, so that's a plus. at least you don't have to undo them to go to the bathroom.

Review_Title: Romantic print, elegant & beautiful - i love it!
Review: Not sure why this shirt is getting bad reviews. i am tall and have a long torso, so perhaps that is the issue for some who find it not so flattering? maybe if your taller it hangs better? i have to say... i love everything about it. it is a fantastic print, it is very flowy but i don't think it's too much in that regard. i think it is fitting with the romantic, girly style of the garment. in my opinion not too short, just right. i took a medium, i am 5'8" and athletic.

Review_Title: Finally found my staple summer clothe!
Review: Was so thrilled to receive my clothe in the mail. its just what i was looking for, for my staple summer clothe. i love how i can wear it with or without the sweater top, and even can pair just the sweater top with my high-waisted shorts!
I don't care because i like be it so much; but, make no mistake, it is not black but rather a dark navy. however please don't let this fall negatively on your decision to buy it. it's fabulous!

Purchased the petite size of these jeans and the length is excellent for my 5'3" height. the description doesn't mention what length the petite size is but i believe it to be 31 inches. the jean is cut small in the hips and snug in the thighs so consider going up a size if you are curvy. magnificent color and style. i may be 60 something but these jeans bring me back to my youth. love them.

Review_Title: Too much pep in this peplum...

I love this tunic, i wore it with black leggings and boots. it is well made and flowy. i wish it came in more colors.

Beautiful thick sturdy denim. probably the best denim i own in terms of the material. the cut can be awkward as it can be tight across the thighs and hips and kinda makes my butt flat. however i love the wash and quality of the material and at a sales price, totally worth it.
There isn't anything i don't love about this clothe! get it before it's gone! i get compliments every time i wear this clothe.
I loved this top so much i bought it in both colors. size down because it run very large, but it is nice and flowy. i'm 5'11" and slim and the top hung nicely on me.

Review_Title: A must for any morrissey fan :)

I cannot say enough excellent things about these jeans...they fit beautifully, have just enough stretch and sit high enough on my waist to cover any unsightly rolls. this was my first pilcro purchase, and i will definitely be adding other styles to my closet in the near future. typically, i'm a size 32 or 14 in denim, but i sized down to a 31 in these after the sales associate made that suggestion. i'm so glad i did...they are a excellent fit!

Review_Title: Pretty color and love the bow
Review: The material is different than i expected, but i like it a lot. the clothe is extremely tight fitting, i will be returning it if i can't figure something out. i'm a 36d and wear a 6, very very restricting in the chest/shoulder area. unfortunately, it may just not be designed for my body type. getting the clothe on was for sure one of my hardest workouts...and i crossfit. oh, and the bow does not come off at all, so good luck with that. the red color is gorgeous, i hope it works out.

Review_Title: Magnificent romper but not for all body types!!
Review: Tried this romper on in store and wanted to love it but it just didn't fit me right. it'a magnificent romper, cute design, super soft-light fabric and overall a magnificent feel but it doesn't work to well for short girls with any types of hips. i have a very small waist and larger bottom and this romper just was very unflattering. i couldn't get the tie waist to sit anywhere that felt like my natural waist, instead it kept giving me a kangaroo pouch and hung on my upper thighs. sizing up didn't help becaus
Beautiful embroidery and good quality jeans. you can really clothe up with these for special occassion.

Oh my gosh do i love this jumpsuit. i am so glad that i bought it. it is beautiful and fits excellently. classy and beautiful and made in the excellent color. the design is slimming as well.there is nothing that i would change about it. i may be wearing this for my 60th birthday this month and am sure i will be getting it out for other occasions in the future. i love it.

This is not even a dolman style sweater because it's loose fitting everywhere around the arm. the point of a dolman sweater is that the sleeves are fitted around the wrist/forearm, but this is not the case with this sweater. it's super loose around the wrist area - i can fit both of my wrists into a sleeve.
Seafolly is my preferred swim/beach brand. the quality is always magnificent! this is a colorful sheer kaftan that will get much use this summer.

The stylist had me try this top on off the shoulders, but that was kind of snug, perhaps why it didn't fit right, it is not off the shoulders on this picture. the cut is loose, so it looked big on me, but going smaller would not have worked the way i had it on... may give it another try on. xs was big, so would need to try the xxs next time. but off the shoulders looked nice on the lady who was smaller built next to me!

colors are nice, light, but appropriate for fall (or summer!) light fabri

I ordered this bra in my normal size 32d, and it fits me excellently. this bra is beautiful. the material seems to be very high quality, and the comfort of this bra is amazing. it's definitely a keeper.

I wanted so badly to love this sweater. the colors in the blue motif are fabulous and the yarn is soft and warm. but it does not fit me in a flattering way. i can't recommend a size, because the s and the m were exactly the same size and fit. the neck is broad and bulky and overwhelming, the sleeves have bulky cuffs that come down to my fingers, and the sweater slides across my shoulders. i'm 5'6". it appeared overstretched, and i feared it would only stretch out more over time and not be worth

Based on the other reviews, i ordered a l and xl even though i would normally order a m. the l fits like a slightly fitted m without being too tight; the xl, of course, is a little larger, but not like a typical xl, certainly not sloppy-looking or oversized. the material is soft and the dark blue is lovely. i will be keeping both sizes. i would most likely not have been happy with a m.

Gorgeous, but the trim detail on both in-store coats was already trashed and falling apart. for $218 and it can't even make it out of the store intact? i love the look but didn't want it to fall apart. they should've done an extra reinforcing stitch on the trim. such a shame!!

This is a gorgeous, well-fitting top! i was hesitant to even try it on because i was sure it would require a strapless bra, which i avoid. nope. worked excellent with my nude bra. i am 32d so need a real bra, but wore an unlined, underwire bra with no show through. magnificent with denim shorts or more polished with clothey trousers or dark jeans.

I have come to scoop up simpleally ever elevenses jumpsuit that they release because they are excellention - always the excellent fit and quality fabric. i'm on the taller side at 5'7" and found this to fit excellently, yet somehow it looks equally as excellent on shorter ladies i saw in the clotheing room. awesome!

Many internet reviews note that byron lars clothees run large and suggest that women 5'5" and under should size down and go petite. i am 5'3" and 101 pounds and the 0 petite size was too snug across my back and too short when i sat down. when i stood up i had to pull the clothe down, as it would bunch up around the hips. therefore, the size 2 regular ended up being a excellent fit, no alterations needed. i was searching for a clothe for an upcoming wedding and for vacation and kept coming back to thi
This is very unique and stylish! the embroidery is stunning plus it is extremely comfortable. it is pretty warm. it does not itch me at all as others have noted.
Magnificent summer shirt. loose fitting, but especially wide. the button gather in back is a nice detail

Review_Title: Excellent coat for cool summer nights
Review: I love this coat! it is stylish and is ideal for a casual night out

Review_Title: Hoped this was the clothe for summer
Review: I have several maeve clothees that fit really well. this was not the case with this clothe. fabric and color are magnificent! fit was off especially in top. worst part was zipper that wouldn't move smoothly. took me a good 15 minutes to get it unzipped. such a bummer!

These chinos are very well made and has a really good fit. not too tight but a bit more relaxed so depending on the look you are going for, these are magnificent! however, i ordered the bright aqua pair and received a pair that is really more teal. a bit disappointed but i'll live. i'm 5'4" with a 30 inseam without shoes. these hit about half an inch below my ankle when not rolled up twice.

I purchased this top on sale and was really excited about the style. it fit magnificent the first time i wore it. i washed it once, according to the care instructions. after washing it in cold water and allowing it to air dry, it was simpleally ruined. it shrunk up in length widened out about two inches. i'm pretty bummed about it because it was cute.

The fabric of this skirt is completely beautiful. however the fit, albeit unique, is not extremely flattering in my opinion. it may be because i am somewhat of a pear/hourglass shape rather than a more straight shape, but the fit is a little off imo. i am 5'8" and 135# and ordered both the 6 & 8 and felt the 8 fit a little better.

One wash wonder...i'm a s to m and went with a m but could have gone with a s with ease. after washing it was way shorter. it shrunk more than a whole size in cold water! i assumed everything came preshrunk but sadly disappointed. magnificent for one wear.

This top runs a bit small, but it's very pretty. i got the ivory and it's beautiful, very form fitting. it is a bit see thru so i will probably wear a tank under it. it's simple tshirt material, so i feel like it should be a bit less $.

This clothe is so pretty and the petite fits magnificent in the arms and the length is good- just above the knees. the material is nice- not flimsy. i'm just not sure if it looks right on my petite, straight frame. the front is cute but the back is pretty baggy and shapeless. i've never worn a shirt clothe so i'm not sure if this is how it's supposed to look? i tried it with a belt but it doesn't seem to work with this clothe as there's a band of loose elastic. probably would look better on a curvier bod

Medium is equivalent to eu size 40. the trousers have the eu tag and i would have ordered differently if i had known this. magnificent quality trouser; just order according to your european equivalent.

I wanted to love this shirt. it's got a thicker material, a flattering shape and the uniqueness for a simple top. however when i put this on, it just looked like it was ill-fitting over the chest. i think if the pull was below the chest, it would be much better.

Review_Title: Like it so much i ordered a second one!
Review: I ordered this in the peach color way. it is a nice, thicker cotton and while i have only worn & washed once (i air dried) it feels like a fabric that will hold up well. fit is good, i stuck with my usual medium. at first i thought it was a little big but i didn't want to risk the arms being too tight or short by going down to a small. in the body a small would have worked i am sure, so if you have slender arms going down a size may work well. i liked it so much though i ordered a second one in

I purchased this sweater in camel and love it. the fabric is very soft and lightweight (excellent for warmer climates with chilly but not cold weather). i'm 5'9" and got a medium, but the sleeves seemed a bit long to me. it's also a bit boxy due to double breasted the cut, so if you have a petite frame it may overwhelm you. otherwise it's definitely a magnificent coat for the money.
This is a magnificent clothe for summer and very flattering!  i am 5'4 and could have pulled off the regular length but chose to go with the petite so that i could wear flats.

With all of the glowing reviews of this clothe, i so badly wanted to adore this very special cocktail clothe. it fit nicely, the quality was magnificent, but there is a decorative (?) line of hook and eyes down the front which come undone with the slightest movement. i wore the clothe out one time and was paranoid the entire time, kept glancing down to make sure i hadn't come unclotheed. i suppose i could've gotten out the needlenose and crimped them all shut, but decided to take it back. i didn't see tha

Based on reviews, i got the medium pink size: 8 petite because some said it was tight in the bust area and pulled at the buttons creating a gap. i'm 5'6" and 32d. i figured the 8 petite would be big enough in the bust area and the petite would be shorter. it was too big and even though it was petite, still too long. wanted to like it, but at full price, decided to return.

I ordered the black and white shirt thinking it was polka dots, but turned out to be stars instead which was even cuter. fits true to size and is very soft and comfortable. my first thought after trying it on was that i should have ordered another one!

This one is a beauty! my store is not carrying the white - they had a lovely blue (periwinkle-ish) that immediately caught my eye. the ivory model shot makes the details of the lace and top layer really pop - more so than the blue variety but both are stunning. the details and layers on this clothe are lovely and intricate without feeling overly delicate. quality most definitely in line with the price.

It is a very pretty bra. light weight and beautiful lace. however, i have yet to find a t-back that does not make me feel like i am going to spill out. to me it ran small. i now know to get a 34 instead. i am working on losing weight, perhaps that might help with the fit?

I wanted to love this top so badly. between the beautiful photos and the good reviews, i didn't think i could go wrong with it. unfortunately, it just didn't look magnificent on. the bust area sagged on my smaller chest, and then the top flared way out from the waist down. it doesn't lay even remotely flat like the photos would have you believe. maybe this would look better on hourglass or slim types. the quality does appear to be good -- the material is weighty and soft.

I usually wear a 4 in maeve, and purchased this is a 6 in the orange. i'm just over 5'7", 34c, size 26/27 jeans. through the bust and arms the 6 fits magnificent. i still found the front to be just a tad shorter than i am comfortable. it hangs well, though, if not a bit loose. definitely more billowy and boxy feeling in person. i think if it were slightly fitted through the waist, the length wouldn't be an issue. and it isn't even that much of an issue, but i did knock off a star for that reason. i bo

I bought this top because i loved the floral print. i had no idea i was getting a top notch quality top. i love the flow of the bottom and the zipper in the back is so classy. it has a lining and the coolest thing about it is the snaps that protect your bra from showing. love love love this top!!

In nature pilco fashion, these jeans are amazing. i wear them rolled down, they have a slight boot cut, but not overly. i am 5'10 and the bottoms fall right to my heel- meaning the hem doesn't drag on the ground-finally the excellent pair of jeans. they also do not stretch out and keep shape after wearin all day! highly recommend, although a little pricy for pilcro, worth the splurge.

I am normally a medium and i would take an xs in this top - i actually tried a m, s and xs and the xs fit but was still big. yes, this is supposed to be a loose draped piece, but for me, i didn't want it to make me look like i was huge through the waist line. the red is really pretty, the white is see thru.

This suit fits like a glove! i've had five kids and am currently nursing my last baby so i was looking for a suit to wear to the beach this summer when i'm just not feeling a bikini. this is it! it's comfortable and not binding easy to nursing and swim in. overall worth the extra splurge. i'm tall too so it was plenty long on my torso.
Love this top! i'm 5' 118 lbs, purchased in a medium and plan on wearing it as a clothe! it is so cute!

I've been moving toward a simple tee and jean wardrobe, and this is the excellent addition! it's so fun and different and so comfortable. i've been loving retailer's new tee's! it runs a little large but in a cute way.

This print/color combination is really pretty. i think it's a little muted compared to the picture, but still very pretty. it is definitely longer than expected - i'm 5'-5" and it almost touches the floor. will definitely need to wear with heels. colors will actually work in the fall with boots and in spring with heeled sandals. it actually has a shorter underskirt, so there's no accidental show. i really like the dark blue wrap #extra fabric at top# - sits below the waist and will help hide imp

This is soooo much more cropped than it looks in the picture. the fabric is super soft and design is cute. i really wanted to like this, but it just doesn't fit as shown. the back is halfway up by back and i am shortwaisted...
To my knowledge this clothe looks magnificent on everyone. the fabric is light and of moderate quality, the finishing is acceptable. a magnificent simple.

Review_Title: Transformed into a crop top with one washing
Review: I loved this shirt until the first time i washed it. it shrunk so much it became unwearable. when i returned it the salesperson said she had also bought this shirt and the same thing happened.

I love this shirt. wore it today and got many compliments. i bought the mauve (looks lilac to me). it's very comfy and long. its got a lovely swing feel which is magnificent for covering my baby belly.

I fell in love with this clothe online, but it just doesn't look as nice in person. first of all, it's huge. i usually take a 4-6 in clothees. i ordered a size 4 in this, and it was like a sack on me. i would have needed at least two sizes smaller. however, after seeing it in person, i didn't love it enough to order a smaller size to get a better fit.
This is a cute casual clothe that could be worn with flip flops or boots.
This midi skirt has a really nice drape with magnificent seasonal colors! can't wait to pair it with my wine color booties!
Really cute and very comfortable. material is thin and sheer. i wear tanks under things anyway, but especially in pink, you would need to. but love the style.
This shirt spoke to me, as soon as i entered the store! i love the colorful plaid, the flattering cut, and the light, airy material. at very least, i think this will be a three-season go to!
I tried the yellow striped clothe on in the store and it is completely sheer.

I ordered this 3 months ago, and it finally came off back order. a huge disappointment. the fit wasn't so much the issue for me. the quality of the wool is subpar. someone else mentioned a "felted wool"...i guess, is that what you call it?  it does literally feel like felt! super thin, itchy, doesn't drape very well, and feels cheap (made in china). i got it on sale, but still not worth what i paid. definitely going back.

The top falls nicely, magnificent quality, the lace is beautiful. however, the sleeves are too wide and puffy. the top is voluminous and i wished it had more form fitting sleeves to balance this out. the top does not look flattering on me so i will be returning it.

While i wanted to love this clothe, i did not like the scratchy lining. i also did not like that the scratchy lining was considerably smaller than the overall swing of the clothe; so it clung to my curves uncomfortably. i wish this had been done in silk, would have been a much nicer material. i returned it.

I ordered the blue in size 16. it ran at least two, if not three, sizes too small compared to my other retailer 14 & 16 blouses. it was too small through the body, other than the peplum. the arms were tight too. the waistline and length matched the online photos. it's widening. the material they chose was also scratchy and rough, especially around the neckline. i returned mine after trying it on and seeing there was no way to make this work. the blue color was gorgeous though. the patterned lace w

Review_Title: Pretty but not worth the price tag
Review: Overall, it's a beautiful clothe, and i really wanted it to work. but the material feels cheap (at least not what you'd expect for the price), and as other reviewers have mentioned, it's just a tad too short. for reference, i'm 5'5, 125 lbs and the 2 fit well, but hung well above my knees. there's no way i could wear this without unintentionally flashing a few people. sadly this clothe will be returned.

I typically wear boring shorts. you know - khaki. i saw these in the store and had to try them on. true to size in the waist, not too short, and the leg fit was excellent (slim without being skin tight). the pattern is far from boring. i can't wait to wear them out.

Here's what i liked:
magnificent shape through body, cool empire waist. and good length
loved the color, more rust than red.
material was somewhat light which liked since i often get overheated in turtlenecks.

here's what i disliked:
the sleeves!! the reason they only show the model with her arms against her body is because the sleeves are ridiculous. they are just too big and too flowy. they will always be in the way of everything and there is no way to roll or push up.

This sweatshirt is very comfortable and the length of the sleeves is very generous! the bodice is short so you may have to wear a camisole or tank top to avoid exposing your tummy. i usually purchase medium sized tops but had to return for an xl! this runs very small.

I'll start by saying the fabric and concept are beautiful. the top is sheer, but that's pretty clear in the images and not surprising for a lightweight white blouse. the problem is that the arms are more fitted and the torso (not the chest, but the mid-section) is cut fairly wide. i'm 5'10", 140#, 34b and usually wear a 4 or a small/medium depending on how relaxed i want the fit. i purchased this in a 4. the arms were workable but slightly fitted, and the torso fit like an 8. chest was as expect

This is such a good clothe to just throw on and go! the inside is lined with fleece so it's simpleally a giant sweatshirt. it does run large. i normally wear a medium and i bought the small but could have bought the xs if the difference in length between the two hadn't been about a foot. (i am tall). the color is actually a light mint, not the grayish blue it appears in the picture. overall a magnificent purchase though.

Review_Title: Loved it, but it didn't work for me.
Review: I wanted this top to work so bad. unfortunately the way the bust of the top is designed it isn't flattering if you aren't flat chested. it squishes on side of your chest and leaves the other side alone. i'm a b cup and had this problem so if you are a b or larger, i don't recommend. however, if you are smaller busted, this piece would be worth the purchase.

This clothe is a good casual summer clothe. the material is thin and feels nice on. the clothe was very wrinkled when it arrived but that came out very easily and the fabric doesn't really wrinkle easily after initial wash and steam. the color is very vibrant and the fit is loose. however, if you have a larger chest (i'm a 34c), the hook and eye closure dones come undone. overall a good purchase. it looks good with a belt as well.
I really love these trousers. just the right fabric, not too thick. so comfy. i do feel they run a bit big. they stretch out quickly so if you are in between sized, choose the smaller one.

Review_Title: Excellent not too wide - wide legs
Review: These are the excellent wide legs.  they aren't overly wide (a common problem for petite women like myself, who cannot pull off the really wide styles), and they are nicely fitted in the top.  the fabric is a magnificent weight, neither too heavy nor too light so they lay nicely. (the similar level 99 linen wide legs with the waist ties have a much lighter fabric that doesn't lay right, and i like these hei hei trousers much better.). i said they run large because i tend the fluctuate between 00p and 0p, a

This sweater is so unique. not for the faint of heart but it's beautiful. hubby thought pattern looked southeast asian inspired. the colors are saturated, vibrant. love the raglan sleeves and the tweed on the sleeves and in the back. the front material is slightly stiffer. i feel like i have a little bit more bulk in the stomach area than i want but i'm willing to overlook it. will be a magnificent sweater for the holiday season. wear it with a skirt, jeans, skinny cargos. endless possibilities.

Review_Title: Pretty colors, but fits like a sack
Review: It made me look extra thick in the middle--could pass for maternity wear. pretty colors. fabric is fine. it's just too shapeless and not flattering on me. i'm 5'11" and it was also on the short side for me. even if it fit better, probably too short for my age (40s).

This clothe is incredibly soft! with sleeves that can be rolled up or down, it is extremely versatile. while the clothe is very comfortable and mostly fits true to size, i found it to be ever so slightly snug through the hips at first. however, i am somewhat difficult to fit with an accentuated hourglass figure. overall, i am very happy with this purchase and look forward to wearing it during my travels!
This clothe is so cute and comfy! i purchased it for my friend's wedding brunch celebration - excellent transitional piece!
I love this tee. really comfortable and super cute too!

This skirt is a magnificent addition to my wardrobe. the print is sophisticated and style flattering on any body. it can be clotheed up or down and could be worn most of the year. maybe not on those hot summer days, but mild ones, for sure with a pop of color tank or t.

Review_Title: Feel like leggings - look like trousers!
Review: Soooooo cute. fit like a dream. look like regular trousers. could clothe up or clothe down. i bought the grey and the slight herringbone pattern was so adorable. going to buy in the black as well. normally wear size 4-6 got the small and fits excellent.

This suit is the most flattering suit i have owned in a while, as well as the most comfortable! though the suit is not lined, the light wetsuit material holds me in and is supportive, despite the open back and the slight looseness of it. if you do any water sports, i think this is a excellent suit. i did purchase some silicone covers for myself, however, to avoid looking like a farrah fawcett throwback.
I love this poncho/sweater. it feels cozy and looks really cool. can't wait til the weather cools down so i can wear it.
Cozy and beautiful - everything dreamy sleep trousers should be. magnificent for gifting. make bedtime feel a little more pampered.

Review_Title: Cute but skip the petite unless you are very short
Review: Beautiful colors, especially the pink. i am 5'3" and about 124 lb. i got the small petite but am thinking of exchanging it for the regular xs. not only is it short hem-wise, which i don't really mind, but it is short in the waist. very pretty and good fabric.
The small is huge on me and the sweater is very itchy. cute idea but not for me. i will return it.

Love the coral color - so pretty in person. it is slightly lower cut on the chest than i expected. 
this is a magnificent top for the weekends!
I purchased this towards the end of winter because it reminded me of spring time! it is such a lovely soft tee, with a delicate flower design. i wear it with jeans. it always makes me feel happy.

This clothe runs large!
i tried on a large, then a medium and then a small! couldn't believe i fit a small! this is a cool, breezy summer ensemble that you can wear anywhere! clothe it up or down, it's comfy and makes you feel like you can breathe under its baggy motif. love it!!

This blouse was exactly what i was looking for. excellent for those last balmy days of summer. fabric a bit sheer, but it flows beautifully and the pleating details and higher neckline make this top truly stunning. it is very flowy, so if you're looking for something more fitted, this might not be for you.

I feel fabulous in this plum and charcoal vest. i am 5/9" and the m'l is the excellent length and size. i was initially attracted by the external seams (and color) and was delighted with the silhouette and soft structure of the wool blend fabric. it is versatile and yet a kind of signature piece that i will wear with joy. .
Beautiful clothe that is very flattering! wearing it to my bridal shower.  more appropriate for spring or summer!

I love these jeans. the fabric is super, super soft with good stretch and give, however they don't loose their shape either. they are mid-rise but a touch higher in the back so you never give anyone an unwanted show when you bend over. my only complaint - and this is just personal preference - is that the back pockets are kind of small. but the comfort outweighs any slight beef i have. for reference, i am 5'4" and wear size 25. comfy, go-to's.

Snap this one up but make sure you order a size larger than your normal size. it runs a full size too small. it sold out before and i was told it wasn't coming back in. i had purchased one previously in my regular size but it was too small. to my delight, it's back, and i've purchased one in the next size up. it's well made, can go from business to sport to casual.

I have owned a lot of stevies in the past. the only problem with them for me has been the rise. i have always thought they would have been excellent with a bit of a higher rise. voila! these have the excellent mid rise (for me). they are really soft. too long for my 29 inch inseam. they bunch at the ankles, but don't drag. i would love for them to have a skinnier ankle, but i also think they're fine how they are. i bought my normal size. they may turn out to be a tiny bit loose after wearing them. t
The softest cotton gauze but, not see through. relaxed but, the sleeves & neckline make it flattering. a gorgeous blue in person. so in love with this clothe, going back for it in white!
Purchased in the blue. the color is a little darker than it shows. more of a slate blue. loved the fit. i am tall so it covered excellently.
Lovely socks, magnificent color, stitched well, a little thin
This clothe is extremely comfortable. the clothe is slightly loose under the armpits, but the other than that the overall fit is magnificent. can be clotheed up or down!

Review_Title: Better looking on that in the picture
Review: So this is available in the store in a reddish coral color, see the #your retailer pictures and you'll see someone wearing it under the gray blazer. anyway, i tried it on and the fit was very flattering for a tunic. the front of the sweater hit me just at the waist and the front draped nicely. somehow the back was slightly hugging my back side but not tight or restricted. i ended up ordering the black and navy online because the fit was fantastic and will go with so many things. nothing shee

Love, love these jeans. being short they come right to my ankle. super soft and don?t require any hemming. i ordered my typical jean size of 26 and they fit like a glove. would love to have these in black and grey.

I wish i had purchased these earlier in the winter season because i could wear them every single day. they are phenomenal, plus i got them during a magnificent sale. the reviews i read said they run small, so i went a full size up and they fit excellently. (i usually wear a 4, bought a 6.) one of the best winter wardrobe purchases i've ever made. totally versatile and because they're black, they can be clotheed up, or down.

Review_Title: Ag delivers as usual but run small
Review: I have several pairs of ag jeans and am always pleased with them. i had to get these when i saw them in the store. i'm a sucker for cuffed jeans in the spring. i also love the dark wash. i was surprised when i tried on my usual size 27 that they were too tight. i ended up going with a size 28. for reference i am 5'4, 122 lbs.

Review_Title: The key to cute fit is to size down
Review: I can see why the other reviewers think this top is huge in the waste - it's wide and not tailored at the waste ! the key to super cute fit is to size down - then it will look like it does on the model in the picture. i went with my regular medium and felt like i was wearing a giant moomoo, so i sized down and it immediately looked like it does on the model in the picture. it's super adorable in person, the collar and the polka dots make this playful yet very clothey and feminine and appropriate

Review_Title: Nice coat to add to my wardrobe
Review: I bought this in rose and i really like the coat. the color is not rose but the picture is accurate. it is more terra cotta as previous reviewer's said. it is pretty casual but you can clothe it up with a chunky necklace and clothey boots. i do wish it was a tad more fitted in the waist. i think it looks better buttoned, but i do wear it open as well.

For some reason they are not replenishing this shirt even though it sells out like wildfire.

Love this t-shirt....i will be wearing this until it wears out. very soft; magnificent fit; and very comfortable....
These trousers feel magnificent. fit is true to size. the blue color is very unique. definitely recommend!

this is the excellent thing to throw on for a casual sexy look...covered, but form-fitting and flattering.

But it runs super small. i wear a medium for everything but couldn't come close to buttoning this. the buttons were about 4 inches apart (horizontally)

probably should have ordered an extra large in order to fit. the quality and styling seemed magnificent but ordering online requires "truth in sizing"

I have this clothe on today in white and i am coming back to buy the second color even though pink is not my preferred. magnificent comfy, casual clothe that pairs well with a variety of shoes and jewelry to clothe it up. highly recommend for summer!

Love this! excellent in the summer with bright, strappy heels or sandals or booties in the winter.

Excellent! wanted a clothe for a mexican vacation. this fits the bill exactly. fabric has enough weight to hang well and cover any "flaws". love!

Review_Title: If they still have your size, buy these

This denim clothe is best worn by someone over 5' 8". i had to spend a lot to have it taken up and it still doesn't look that magnificent. so if you don't want to pay over $200 once altered, do not buy this clothe.

the best part of the clothe is the top. it was true to size on top.

This is a magnificent white clothe for summer.

i think for a narrow frame or a smaller chest, this would be very flattering.

(i'm a 6-8, should have purchased the 27's.)

this tank has some stretch, so i imagine it fits a range of siz

I had been looking for a new plaid shirt for fall. this one is excellent! the yellow is muted, but i really like it that way. other reviewers have commented on poor quality, but it doesn't seem that bad to me. definitely recommend!

Love the print and loose fit. doesn't look to wide on my top heavy torso and the sleeves don't cling to my chubby upper arms or tummy. wore all day today, first with shorts then with cropped jeans.
The color is magnificent, a nice alternative to all my black tights. good quality.
The tshirt is comfy and has a little curve on the tail which is fun!

This clothe is nicely made and hangs beautifully. i did find the shoulders a bit too wide even though i have pretty broad shoulders. then again, i'm also pretty tall and the length on this clothe is really nice, so i'll take the slightly wide shoulders. the low back and gathered waist are very flattering. a excellent clothe to wear in the summer!
Appears much more sleek in the photograph. in real life, this shirt looks more like a pajama top. thin, extremely casual, not worth the price i paid- even in black. will be exchanging it tomorrow.

I was so excited to receive this clothe. i got a petite 4 as i am 5'2". it was very hard to zip up the side zipper but not impossible. it didn't look good on me. the waist line was a bit too high...maybe a regular would have looked better. also i thought it was a cotton clothe but it isn't. also i looked like i was going to a nordic folk festival to do a traditional dance. i had been so excited to receive this but sadly it just didn't work for me and i had to send it back.

The girls at the local retailer are big fans of coh, & i've been thinking maybe i shld try them out. i ordered these online in the size 29, as i am usually a 28/29 in skinnys. i am a little hard to please, or say hard to fit in skinny jeans. i like a snug good looking skinny but not so much if it's uncomfortable. paying full price it is expected for the look & fit to be excellent. even if on sale, i won't go it if i think something is not right for me. at 5'3", 117#, slender legs, skinnys are either

I tried this shirt on in store, and loved it! it has a flattering fit and is very comfortable. i read some other reviews about the quality not being good, i don't feel that way at all. the knit and the silky/satiny materials both feel like quality to me. the one concern i have is that it may wrinkle easily. i'm 5'4'' and 125lbs and the xs fits well. i plan to pair it with skinny jeans.

Review_Title: I wanted to love this shirt.
Review: I order this shirt because it looked like a shirt you could clothe up or down. when i got it the shirt was really wrinkled. therefore, i knew it would have to ironed a lot. it was quite boxy and was shorter in the front then in the back. i didn't realize that this shirt was two different fabrics. overall i think this shirt would be more flattering on a woman that was petite.

Review_Title: Works for casual and business casual
Review: This is a lovely blouse. i think is a bit roomy, but even so, i like the look. i have to clothe business casual for work and this blouse fits the bill as it's not too casual.
Beautiful and high quality. unfortunately it made me look top-heavy. i am a 36dd .
Giving 3.5 stars due to how big this clothe runs. i am 5' 118lbs and i was swimming in the xs. it is a beautiful clothe, just beware it runs very large.

Review: I got the burgundy color and i do have to say that the color looks a little better online than it does in person, but it's not too much of a difference. this is a really cute thong, and if you're just trying to be sexy/romantic, then i think it would be fine and there's nothing at all wrong with it. however, i like to wear thongs just in general because i think they're comfortable and i like not having to worry about trousery lines, and this is definitely not the most comfortable. the front pattern

 nice light material cute fit 
 unfortunately didn't like the pink color was too bright for me  ( and although i ordered an extra extra small petite they sent me an extra small petite which is just slightly too big )and saw the mango in the store which i also didn't like the color

What a magnificent sweater! the pale pink is sweet but the grey was more my style. i'm 5'5" 120 (34c) and the xs is excellent. i know everyone is saying this sweater runs large but i believe this style is meant to be a bit oversized, so i would call it true to size with that in mind. the arms are long, the shape is boxy (but not short) and i love the way it hangs on my thin frame. it's super soft & cozy; will easily be a go-to sweater this fall.
I got this in the teal and the color is beautiful and i get so many compliments! definitely size down. i am athletic and usually a m and i ordered a small.

Review_Title: Fits nicely but fabric a bit thin

Beautiful clothe, wonderful fabric, very well made, just runs really small! so sad, i wanted this clothe for a special event!

I have been needing a rain coat and saw this one on sale, so decided to try it on. i do wish it was more "fitted", but it is pretty cute. the embroidered detail is nice. too bad the xs petite is sold out. i have no idea if it will hold to the rain though...

While the white version is a tad more twee, this one in black is edgier, more sophisticated. tts for my 33" chested, broad shouldered self in a 4. all the unique details add up to an outstanding, versatile piece: how it blouses out in back; opaque enough to wear without a cami; the scallops?i may keep both colors!

I purchased this sweater in the blue and i love the color. at first i bought the regular size extra small. i am 5/2" and 102 pounds. i had to return the xs for the xxs petite. i like the arms to be long so i don't usually purchase sweaters in the petite sizes, but this one in the xxs petite the arms are still plenty long enough. it is still very roomy. it is very soft and comfortable, slightly itchy, i wear a very thin long sleeve shirt underneath.

This is a beautiful quality knit. i do wish that it was a tad bit longer...i'm 5'7" with a long torso and found it to hit like the model shot. since the sweater flares a little at the bottom, i think it might be more flattering a little longer. keeping this regardless because it will still get plenty of wear.

Review_Title: Shirt and or coat, with a flair
Review: I dig this coat very much because i can wear it like a thick shirt or as a coat, and the removable collar gives even more versatility. i am short so i opted for regular xs (i'm 5ft2in, 34b, 26 waist, 36 hips), the bit of spandex stretch helps me achieve the fitted look without looking too tight. i love military green color, it's a happier neutral than black or brown. without saying, it goes with everything and flatters all body types.

The excellent cardigan for transitional seasons! i live in southern vermont and i can already tell this cardigan will be in heavy rotation during the summer to fall and spring to winter transition times. has such a cute back detailing that gives you a break from your common cardigans. magnificent quality. i'm 126 lbs 5'4 and i got the small petite and is excellent if you want it to be slightly loose but not swimming in it!

Soft fabric, the blue is a nice color, rich. the drape effect is very flattering on the body. the length of the regular xs was fine on me, i often get petite but would not need it in this case. could wear this with jeans or clothe it up with a nice skirt. good simple.

I love this clothe, even more when i ordered it. its really flowy and flattering. i was worried it would make me look a bit frumpy with the seam right under the bust, but its so flattering. it also has little ties on the sleeeves in the back, a detail i'm in love with.

This is sure to become my preferred shirt! this shirt is feminine and the fit is excellent. the white lace is strategically placed, so you do not have to wear a cami on those hot summer days, but you can for the work day. i cannot wait to wear this!!

These trousers were pretty different then my typical style, but i love them! they come down a bit longer then i think they are supposed to because i have shorter legs, but i still think they are cute- especially with a heel or clog. good quality, well made.

Review_Title: Adorable, comfortable, flattering; this has it all
Review: I was not shopping for a clothe and somehow came home with this. in person the material and embroidery are just so stunning that i found myself picking it up. i was sold after trying it on. the material is very soft, both feels and looks extremely high quality. and for a simple shirtclothe, it is amazingly flattering. follows curves without clinging to them. i'm 5'4", 123 lbs, usually wear a small in tops/clothees & purchased the size 4, which fit excellently. i'm slightly chesty (34d) so sometimes ha

This top is so darling, the different textures are so elegant that you really don't even need to accessorize. it has a very flattering cut and a must for any figure.

I loved the criss cross part of this tank. however, it looked so frumpy on. the cut was just odd and if you are petite it felt like a tent. i was so bummed because that criss cross was awesome but it just looked so weird on. i returned it. the material felt nice too.
I love this poncho. i would wear it to the beach or even for fun outing like wine tasting!

The shoulder bearing aspect makes this top sexy yet it doesn't look like you're trying too hard. sleeves can be worn up or down and everything stayed in place either way. i get tons of compliments each time i wear this.
I love the way this clothe feels and falls. . if you like a form-fitting bodice this is not the clothe for you, but the drape and cut is flattering and comfortable.
