Love, love this tunic. my size 4 fits excellently with a little room, material is very soft and very comfortable. could be worn with leggings or with a belt as a clothe...so many options. so worth it!!!

I can't believe these aren't sold out yet.  i had no problem getting this over my head.  this top has such beautiful colors and embroidery.  quality is good.  flattering on.  at this price, it is probably the best deal i've gotten on anything from retailer.  i would recommend this top, completely!

I purchased the mustard colored item and it is very good for spring. nice fit, nice quality

i could send it back

Love this skirt! i enjoy being trendy, but i love the retro vibe. can be clotheed up, or worn to work.

Review_Title: Magnificent twist on a pencil skirt
Review:
I love the style and quality of this skirt. the material is a bit heavier than anticipated, so it works well in cooler months, and the thickness makes it easy to wear a shirt underneath. it fits true to size - my usual 6 is form-fitting without being overly snug or pulled.

i am on the taller side, and the skirt is fairly long - it comes to the bottom of my knee.

J brand is by far the best premium denim line retailer sells! the fit on these jeans is amazing..worth every penny..also, considering it is a crop jean - warm weather wear - the denim weight is light and not too thick...the color is different from ordinary regular denim blue..lighter wash for spring/summer!

Nice vest, pretty olive color, hangs nice but...its just kinda funny. just hangs and really looks odd when tied. i like the laying piece just wished it had more "umph".
I love this tunic. i am 22 weeks pregnant and the large fit magnificent. i wish it were a little longer but will be magnificent with leggings and excellent for the fall/winter seasons.

Review_Title: Cute on the model, too tight in person
Review: I loved the cut and style of this shirt, so was very disappointed when i put it on and it was very tight and slightly see-through. if you do order it, get it in a size larger.

I love drop shoulder sweaters and find them to be very flattering so i took a chance on this one despite the reviews stating it runs very large. i was attracted to the style as well as the natural cotton fiber, which i find holds up best over time. i am 34b and usually wear xs or small and in this i ordered the xs. it fits excellently! i layered this soft pink sweater over a rounded hem tee with a black and white pattern; so cute! it is slightly short on my 5'8" frame so the shirt tail hems peeked
Excellent clothe for lounging in the house or for sleeping. very comfortable and a little sexy at the same time.

This clothe pops! gorgeous colors and simple, classic flowy design. i thought it ran a little big, i ended up with xs for best overall fit in chest and a more streamline flow. 34b for reference.

I received this clothe today and can not be happier. i'm 5'6", 120 lbs, 34c, and the 2 fits excellently, hitting about 1.5" above my knees. the print is so pretty and elegant. the colors aren't too vibrant, aren't too muted. the collar and french cuffs give the clothe an extra flair. it comes with a little slip because the clothe is sheer. i just tried it on with suede booties and it looks adorable! i'm ready for cooler temps to arrive so i can wear it!

I love the look of this clothe & had high hopes, but it didn't live up to them. have no doubt that it is well made & beautiful, fully lined with lovely detailing around the neck. i am 5'6", 155lbs with a postpartum belly that i'd like to hide, so i chose this clothe as the reviews say it's a bit loose & forgiving. i found it to be so loose that it looks big & entirely hides my figure! i considered ordering a small, but knew that it was simply the cut of the clothe & going down a size wouldn't chang

Love this clothe! the light fabric quality, color, and design all added to the grecian goddess feeling! my usual 0 fit excellently, giving me a magnificent shape and the length is magnificent!

Review_Title: I wanted to love this clothe ...
Review: But, it just doesn't measure up. first, the slip/lining comes unattached if pulled slightly and it is very difficult to actually get it on - either stepping into it or pulling it over your head. and, once on, the top was a big snug and there was too much material at the bottom which made it look really bulky. unfortunately, i am finding this to be the case with so many of the items i buy from retailer lately. the material is really cute, but the clothe isn't worth the price / effort.
This beautiful blue sweater was exactly what i wanted!

The fit on this shirt is bizarre--it very much resembles a nursing top (but wouldn't actually work for that purpose). the side visible in the picture is nicely draped, but the other side can flap open and is completely different. i tried two different sizes and both were equally unfortunate!
Cute and simple top. a little tight through the bust. looks magnificent tucked or out, and super cute with a simple coat. easy piece to clothe up or down.

Pros: versatile summer weight t. excellent with jeans. flattering cut. nice color palette. made in the usa. reasons for not giving 5's for overall rating and quality... shirt is a bit short overall (i'm 5'4). fabric is thin and a mixed blend of poly, cotton, and rayon. will have to be careful with washing. better if you can purchase on sale. regular price was steep for a t-shirt.
I just purchased this cardigan, it is better in person than the picture. the fit is fabulous, it is very versatile. it can be worn with many different options, definitively be wearing often.

Love this layered turtleneck clothe. super cute and super comfy. love the contrastin pattern and fabric of the top half and the skirt. also the skirt is very hip hugging as shown in the photo, with the result being flattering. i wore it to work with sweater tights and boots (winter in seattle) and felt completely put together.

Love this one. i usually wear a medium, got this in medium and fits excellently. i agree with the prior reviewer regarding the arms, they are a little snug, but i like the fit just as is. the pattern and medium thinkness were just what i was looking for.

This tunic is beautiful! the color is a vibrant blue. i can wear it with jeans or clothe it up with my white linen capris! i ordered the small and it fits me excellently!!!

Review: I am 5"7" and weigh 123 lbs. i tried on both these clothees in medium, and they both fit. they are not too thin, not too high slit, not scratchy. the problem is i am middle aged with a thick waist. the waist looked lumpy with the close fit knit. if you are younger, slim and tall, you will love it. i sent it back with regrets. hope this helps.
I'm really looking forward to wearing this skort on vacation in hawaii. it's a magnificent color, soft, flowy, fun, practical.

Excellent party clothe - well constructed, bra hidden at arms and on top, what more can you ask for? i felt like betty draper the moment i put it on. i'm normally a 6, but the 4 (while fitted) looked amazing and didn't pull.

Like the other reviewer said it's hard to get on and i had to size down like i often do at retailer. but it's so pretty and it's not too short like most rompers. we host thanksgiving every year and i'm so excited to find an alternative to a clothe/trousers so i can work & cook in style.

These are more than what i had expected! they're beautiful and fit like a glove. i'm thrilled that i purchased them.

I am on the fence about this clothe. the fabric is gorgeous and soft. however, i was hoping the fit was more slouchy like pictures on the model. it was much shorter on me that pictured (for reference i am 5'7) and the turtle neck part of the clothe is kind of high and tight. i wanted to love this so much, but it is a touch off from what i was hoping it was going to be.
Beautiful and chic. so glad i tried it on!

Just received these trousers today and i completely love them! the material is super soft and the fit is true to size! i ordered the tan color. i really like the wide leg and the frayed bottom!! i may order the gray too!

Review: I was expecting these to be the normal thickness of everyday leggings, plus fleece. instead, they're more like thicker-than-average tights. still warm, though there's a weird seam on the inside of the thighs that takes away from some of the comfort. not so bad that i want to return them, but not what i was hoping for, either.
This skirt is very comfortable and fits tts or even runs a bit large. i was able to clothe it up with a magnificent white shirt and statement necklace. magnificent find.

Review_Title: Didn't fit well for me, but well-made
Review:
I ordered this in size xl and it ran small. i'm a pear-shape and thought this style would be flattering. i have a few other peplum-style sweatshirts from retailer that are my preferreds. but, the cut on this is tighter so the bottom layers gap and don't flow well. i found it to run short too. it's cut one size too small. i would have sized up but, being xl, there's no option for that. i'm returning mine.

These bottoms are very cute but defiantly cheeky! i would recommend sizing up if you want to have more coverage.
Yikes!  quite a smell off of this one- like wet/hot wool.  the color was beautiful, but the sweater is enormous!  strange fit under the arms as well.  this one went back the same day.
This lacey clothe fits well and is very comfortable.

Review: Loved the colors but the fit was less to be desired. very wide under arms & too much material. looks more like a maternity clothe. i ordered a small petite & would have needed the xs but now it is no longer available. oh well. returning this.

Cute off-the-shoulder top with a dark floral motif totally on trend for fall. as previous reviews mentioned, material is ribbed, which makes it look a bit like corduroy. but, it is not thick so it just makes it seem more appropriate for colder weather. i think it will be magnificent with skinny jeans and a choker.

I love these shorts, nice material, good fitting, and magnificent look. i sized up, usually an 8 and i ordered a 10 based on others reviews and it was the right choice. these are a magnificent casual short or clotheed up with shoes and a nice shirt.

This is a stunning blouse! you can't tell from the photo, but it looks very 1930-1940's. i am so happy with this blouse, it is gorgeous. i'm an xl, and purchased this blouse in xl and it fits wonderfully. it fits nice and flowy and i feel i don't need a cam underneath. i highly recommend it!

Review_Title: Very soft material, color is different in person

After reading other people's reviews, i was afraid it might be too long. i ordered the regular xs as all the petite a were sold out. i found the length to be excellent and i am only 5'2".
Really cute clothe for work. fits exactly as i expected. this clothe is very comfortable and looks put together on days when you're being lazy and just want to "throw something on".

This is the first thing i saw when i walked into retailer and immediately snagged it. it is so flattering and true to size. pretty colors, unusual styling. there is nothing about this beauty that i don't like!

I have a pair of mih jeans that are the only jeans i own that i completely love. everything about them. this jumper looked versatile, useful and fun, so i splurged during the 25% off clothe sale.

my experience with mih is that the sizing runs true, or european, and thus small. i ordered this in a medium and it is gargantuan as well as virtually shapeless. it looked horrible from every angle: front, back and sides. i cannot imagine it having more fit even in a smaller size.

I love this skirt! so soft and comfortable, i wore it casual with black nike sneakers, a black loose turtleneck top and a moto leather coat. i tried on the m and l and went with the m, so i would say it is true to size because that is what i usually wear. i'm 5'9', 145 lbs,
nice thick fabric, but not heavy, good for cool weather.

This clothe is a lovely fit. the knit top accentuates the bust and the loose skirt below the empire waist just skims the figure. it's pretty casual and the skirt is a tiny bit sheer so better for weekends than for office wear.

The clothe is very pretty, however the description is deceiving. i purchased it not just for the look but because it was listed as "silk" but that is not exactly true. the under-slip is silk but the outer clothe, what you see is definitely not. it is a cheap, thin material on top, skirt is stiff,, not loose or flowy as the picture would have you think. i will keep it, very happy i did not pay full price.

Review_Title: Very cute clothe, but odd sizing
Review: The pattern and fabric are very nice! i'm usually an 8/m for clothees. it was very narrow across the top (and i have a small chest), but hung very low in the armpit. i guess if you're small up top, this might fit better.

This gorgeous sky blue sweater was already in the clotheing room to try on; i was not shopping for anything like this whatsoever. well, i tried it on and decided it was a must-buy. i usually need a petite in sweaters and coats, but this one, because i prefer a longer length, fits just fine, and the sleeves are not too long. the color is beautiful. it seems to be warm enough for sf evenings. it think the price is quite reasonable for a sweater/coat like this. a magnificent purchase!

Review_Title: Stunning and worth the full price.
Review: Completely beautiful and well made. this pair of jeans is excellent, no flaws whatsoever. i usually wear size 27 but bought the 26 as it fits better. 27 is very slightly loose but i think it supposed to be like that for a boyfriend jeans. i prefer it nice and fitted, so 26 works better. i'm lucky to find them still available in the store while it's not online. i didn't hesitate to buy at full price, which i rarely did. i'm so in love with my new purchase. very happy!

If all the tops i ordered from retailer this summer, this top is my fav. it is a crowd pleaser! my friend called it my "art shirt." the fabric is nice and the cut hangs nice on my 5 ft 5 170 pound frame. the armholes are a little big, so i just wear a red bra with it and it's magnificent.

I am sorry to say this blouse is way below all retailer standards. this top should have been placed on sale a long time ago! poor quality in cut, fabric, design. this is a top one would grab at a local box store for 19.99. the colors are not as vibrant. the shoulders ill fitted. and the fabric and threads are very cheap. i was expecting so much more.sorry retailer.....my preferred store to shop!

Got lots of complements on this one. worn to work with skinny trousers and a chunky necklace. classic look with a twist. would also look adorable with jeans as shown.

This is one of those clothees that looks so cute on the model but doesn't look anything like that in reality. it has no shape and it fits weirdly all over. i am normally a m and i ordered the s and it is massive.

I like the clothe on line: color flowers, cut, etc. but when i tried it on it was just meh... the color did wash me out a bit, the flowers are still beautiful, but the cut wasn't as flattering on my body as it was on the model. 0p fit ok, but i didn't keep it. you ahve to tie your own shoulder straps, so adjustable, i guess that is a plus.

115 lbs 30 dd, 26.5 in waist

Review: I am a true size xl. in my 20s i wore a small and then medium, so i know whereof i am speaking here. i tried this clothe on in my local retailer store. this designer, as a handful of retailer designers seem to do, simply enlarges the fabric measurement outward as they add another size. the problem is... a funny thing happens to women's breasts as they gain weight. is this so difficult to understand? as a size small i was an a cup, as a medium i was a b cup. now, years later, as a size 16 i am a d cup

Love this top.
excellent under a coat for work or on its own for date night. i have a long torso and the length is excellent. so dainty and different!

Very comfortable and love the color. i'm a bit curvier on the bottom and the small still fit me fine.

This style is right up my alley and i was excited to receive it. however, it is seriously overpriced. i ordered the white and the material is thin and see-through. the small was even a bit roomy (5'7", 140lbs, 32dd). going back unfortunately.

Review_Title: Feels lovely to the skin; 1 important flaw for me
Review:

it is tts and hangs nicely on the body, even for gals with longer backs. there was no issue of see-through with the blue (hopefully the pink is the same) due to the dark color and thicker material. the sides are a tad see-through, but only at the cap sleeves! the rest is well lined.

my only complaint is the v-cut at the chest; it's entirely too low for my liking. every t

I didn't think i would like this blouse when i saw it on the website but once i tried it on i was sold. yes, it is see-through but with a cami underneath this blouse can be worn both casually and to work. the best feature? even though it's silk and the tag says "dry clean only", you can completely hand wash this blouse in cold water and air dry. i did and it came out excellent with no wrinkles! i took my usual small (i'm 32c and 122 lbs) and love how versatile this blouse will be.

This sweater is gorgeous in print but in person the colors are murkier. the yellow dots are really a dusty mustard yellow and the navy is a smokey navy. the white background reads more oatmeal in person.

I am a 36dd, 10/12 in tops and 12/14 in bottoms.

Colors washed me out, i need more vibrant colors. so cute on the model

Saw this on line and bought right away! excellent romper for summer- color is magnificent and fabric is soft- like all cloth and stone chambray. it fits pretty true to size, maybe a little small when putting on, but i think it will stretch out a little. i didn't want it baggy. fits magnificent through hips and booty looks good! i will wear with flip flops, sandals, or wedge. i also got 15% off which made deal even better!

I love almost all tops from retailer, however this one was just enormous. it is beautifully designed, but it was so huge when i tried it on that i couldn't believe it was sized 0. i even checked the tag to see if maybe they placed a size 0 tag on an xl shirt. for reference, i am 5'2" and 110lbs. i would have loved this shirt if it hadn't been so big.

I was very excited to get this but very disappointed once it arrived. the fabric on the back is thin and clingy. i think you'd have to wear a slip underneath. cute design on the front but sadly it's going back.

Review_Title: Simple cute tee with a twist
Review: Love the tee in the red. it's not too sheer and the metal detail on the shoulders turns it from a simple tee to a tee with a little more pizazz. fits true to size. i take either a medium or large in retailer and this in a size large fits well. it is a bit boxy, but not sloppy. on sale it's a magnificent deal.
This may be one of the cutest items that i have every owned! runs big, i am a 4 and the 0 fits excellently.
This coat fits just a tad big, but it's quite comfortable. it's the excellent touch to clothe up jeans! i've gotten lots of compliments.

Review_Title: Very nice, but not for me
Review: The fabric and color are very nice, as is the cut, however this is entirely unsuited to someone as short as i (5'3"). i also have a proportionally short torso, so the split hits in the completely wrong place. someone taller is likely to love this.

I just tried it on and it fits well, with no extra room. it seems like a nice fall piece to have in your wardrobe. the color leans more towards green. now i have to figure out what to put on top when i wear it!

The sweater is beautiful and lightweight. it is very short. i am short-waisted but felt that it was too cropped for me. the deign is lovely and the fabric is soft.

Love! love! love! i got this jumper right before it started getting hot and it has been my go to all summer! fun night out with the girls.. excellent! walking around the mall... awesome! at work with a green vest... super! every time i wear this i get tons of compliments! did i mention it feels like you're wearing pajamas which in my book is everything! get it!

In the fall and winter, i live in my uniform of skinny jeans, boots and a long sweater. this cardigan will be excellent! the fabric is very nice quality and the colors are gorgeous. i can see myself wearing it over and over!

I went into the store to buy this in white after seeing it on the website. i ended up with the blue/gray color. the white was completely see thru. could have worked as a swim cover- but not at this price for me. the blue on the other hand is fine. the fabric is soft and hangs nicely. you can definitely clothe it up with some booties and a belt, or keep it laid back with flip flops. i'm sure i'll wear this a bunch this summer. the color is versatile enough that i will pair with leggings and boots

I was a little skeptical to buy this clothe at first because of the pattern. in all honestly, i am so happy that i did. it's so unique and truly a one of a kind design. when tried on the clothe is very slimming.

Review_Title: Very cute, but impossible to put on
Review: I wrote item ran large, but that was true only in length. it would be long for someone 5'10" . however the bigger issue is getting it on. the style and quality are quite nice, but it does have some issues.

This is a beautiful piece--and a really magnificent deal on sale. it is sheer, but with a simple slip underneath it will work well for a comfortable but special-looking summer outfit!

I tried this tunic at a store and loved it. i had to buy a much bigger size because the sleeves are so narrow.
the 12 fit ok but the sleeves are so tight it hurt. i have normal arms and i am so glad i was at a store to try a bigger size.

Another reviewer said it best, "i love the way this clothe makes me feel." i couldn't agree more. the lines are excellent and effortless. 
with all the different reviews on size, i went into the store to try it on. i am usually always a s or m at retailer and a s fit excellently. i think sizing down any more takes away from the casual look of the clothe. i am 5' 5", 130, and have a small bust.

I got these in gray and ultimately returned them only because i already have a similar pair of trousers. they fit true to size and the quality is fantastic. i usually do poorly with trousers that zip on the side because of my small frame, but i had no problem with these at all. i may go after the other colors!

I adore this shirt. like a previous reviewer, the shirt runs a little small in the bust. i got a 6 instead of my typical 4 and it looks magnificent. the quality is magnificent and the color is lovely. the feel of the fabric is nice substantial weight.

Love this sweater! the abstract floral design adds an understated romantic touch, the red is a beautiful rich red, and the cotton is super soft and comfy. i've tried it on with pencil skirts and jeans, and it looks magnificent with both. i'm considering buying it in the off white too, but it does have some cons. one is the waist band hits me where it does on the model and if you look closely you can see where the sweater poof out over the band a bit--it does that on me too, unless i turn the band up t
Very nice quality!! awesome style, the fabrics is so soft but very durable!! this top will be magnificent with jeans or a denim skirt!!

I was hoping that this would be a nice neutral layering staple but it simply leaves a lot to be desired. it fits tts, length is fine...the inside is some, but the outside darker material is stiff and cheap (kinda canvas feeling?). the material is super stiff which makes it flare out like like a tent in a super unflattering way. it also is on the thinnish side - it looks in the model shot like it would be a little thicker and warm. this is definitely going back.

Do not buy this clothe for full price. the design looks magnificent but after receiving the clothe, the material is made of extremely cheap slinky-ish polyester that you would find at a f21 store. the stitching is horrific and created an uneven "hump" on the back seam. just completely poor poor quality.

I actually like my shirt more than the other reviewers it seems. i am little (5'1" and 103) and i don't think it's too boxy at all. i like the way it hangs. and i'll say i like it much more in person than on the model. it's somehow cozier than it looks in the picture. it's a real boosh (that mean's comfy.) i wouldn't have picked it from the online pic, but in person, it really caught my eye.

I love these trousers. the material is so nice and well made. i love the glittery threads within the pattern. the waistband is elastic which is good for me as my waistline fluctuates. these trousers can be clotheed up or down. the length was excellent and hit at my ankle (i'm 5'3). the only flaw is that i wish the trouser leg was slimmer around the ankle. it would be a more flattering look. . 

one thing to note: if you have a big butt or do not like to emphasize that part of you, these are not the trousers

I got the floral suit and honestly, it's the most beautiful bathing suit i have ever owned. i have yet to wear it to the pool or beach so i don't know how it holds up when getting wet. i can see where other reviewers have said there is no support in the chest. it is padded which is nice, but no underwire or anything to hold the girls up. if you are big chested this could be an issue - not so much for me. :) looking forward to wearing this suit when the weather gets warmer!
My new preferred sweater for layering!! excellent color, length and fit. i am 5"4, 125 and purchased my usual small. if you're on the fence about this one i say try it on it's totally worth it!

I got them in green and the color is very nice.
the waist is a little higher than the ag cords, but that only makes them comfortable and holds the tummy in a little
good length and the trouser holds up nice thru out the day, no sagging yet in the knee and behind area

I don't usually spend this much on a top but despite the high price, i really love the style. i like that it's made out of cotton and it can be worn down on the shoulders or left up. looks cute both ways. i ordered the xs which is usually my size. it fits excellently. i imagine the s would have fit also. it hits just at the hips. i have a long torso so i would have liked it a bit longer, but it's not a deal breaker. my one splurge this summer.for reference 123 lbs, 5'5', 32 d.
This is a magnificent winter addition to any wardrobe. warm but not hot. looks magnificent with tights as a clothe or with leggings. so many compliments.

Such quality went in to this clothe - it is beautiful. the torso is lined and the tulle is not super poofy at the waist. it is, however, not made for the busty gal. i am a 32 dd, the fabric comes in at the arm pits making for narrow coverage around the chest. also this clothe is short waisted, it is almost an empire on me. i wish it worked, as it is lovely. perhaps it will work on the someone super thin? so sad about it!
Here's an example of lowering a hemline and slapping the term 'petite' on it. too much fabric, was bulky, and ran too small. the fabric was thin and pulled awkwardly over the bust. returned..

I love everything about this skirt! the fabric is super comfy and it drapes wonderfully. fits magnificent. a bit long for me as i'm 5'6 but totally worth it. i don't wear heels so i might need to alter the length, but i knew it would be long when i ordered it. i purchased the grey, but i might have to order the taupe as well!

I bought this is in the gray color, although imo it has more of a greenish hue. i love it. it's a wide boxy fit like others have said, and tends to fall off the shoulder. i purchased it in the small (my typical size) and it definitely seems to run large (it relaxes too as i wear it, giving it an even roomier feel). that said it's very cozy & comfortable. i wear a tank underneath. works well for 50's and 60's weather.

Magnificent clothe! i am always looking for knee length clothees that are comfortable and easy to wear. i am really active with my kids and this clothe can be worn on a casual day with sandals or clotheed up. the fit was flattering for me, although i am not very curvy and could see that it might not flatter all shapes. i am 5'5'' and 120 pounds and the size four fit magnificent.

the only thing for me is that i have long arms so the sleeves have to get pushed up, but it looks like that's how it's supposed to be.

For reference i am wearing a medium in the photos and my measurements are 38-30-40.

Magnificent quality and beautiful color! i wear size 6 and ordered s. got lots of compliments :)
Such a magnificent classic top! very flattering! can be worn all year. i bought it in grey but think i'll need it in other colors!

Like other reviewers have said, this item runs extremely long and large. i could have fit my body in one trouser leg they were so wide--much wider than any standard wide leg trouser i've owned. sadly had to return.

I bought this well made cute top today and love it. it can be day time casual or clothey for dinner. you will want to probably wear a cami underneath since its see through. its excellent for summer! im a 36d, 5'7" 135 pounds, and usually wear a medium, but the small fit excellently with room to spare. cuter in person.

Review:
I wore this blazer for one day, didn't do anything strenuous, and the fabric started to disintegrate along the back, next to the center seam. it's completely unfixable, since it's not the seam that split but the fabric itself. what a waste of money.

as to the fit, it is a boxy cut through the waist. it looks better unbuttoned than buttoned. the coat also shows a lot of the shirt you have under it, so it's good over something cute.

Review_Title: Magnificent concept, too roomy, elastic band looks meh
Review: I really wanted to love this, but it was just too voluminous to be flattering. i am typically a size 10 or 12 in clothees and jumpsuits, and the medium was billowing around me. also,the elastic waist hit me low and bunched in an unflattering way. it had to go back.

This is a magnificent tee.... i bought this in the green in a size m. i'm normally a small but because of the fitted look, i opted for the medium. i probably could have sized down to the small, but the medium is still fitted just not too tight, which is actually a nice look. the only thing i wish was different are the sleeves. the sleeves are just a little too puffy for me, but it's so cute that i'm keeping it.
This tank was much needed for my wardrobe. i love the vivid colors and forgiving cut. i am 130lbs and purchased an xs .

This clothe has all the hallmarks of a classic. the fit of the bodice is form enhancing but modest and the flare is very feminine and swingy. i love the soft denim fabric though it smelled funny out of the package and i had to air it out. i am 140# 36dd and bought the size 8.

I'm in love with this top! looks just like it does in the photos, except the colors are maybe a little more vibrant. it's definitely boxy, so you may not like it if boxy isn't your thing, but i think the pattern placement really works with the boxy shape. i usually wear a small in tops and the xs/s fits magnificent. it's also machine wash and tumble dry which is a plus (although i haven't washed it yet). unique, chic, and effortless...order before it's gone!

This lightweight sweater arrived within a few days of ordering and was packaged well. its fit is true to size and will be excellent for slightly cool days and evenings. the navy blue color is accurately represented in the picture. my only issue with this item is that one of the small lace panels at the hem on the hip is not sewn in all the way. i will keep it since it was on sale, but i need to decide whether to have it fixed or to just remove both of them as they are very small and don't add much

Even following the care label exactly, it shrunk ~3 inches in the length and overall in the diameter. i had to return this since i am tall and it looked more like a work-inappropriate mini after the first wash.

overpriced, to boot.

These run small in the thighs and behind just like most of the other cartonnier trousers. i have four pair of cartonnier trousers that are all size 10...which is a size or two up from my usual 6 or 8 in other styles. print is magnificent! fabric is super lightweight and magnificent for summer.
This robe is warm, soft and i like how long it is! it's excellent length. my preferred thing to wear around the house!

I bought a size small in this clothe even though i am usually a large at retailer. it just hung strangely and clung to the unflattering parts of my body but seemed very large. i loved the feel, color (grey) and style of the clothe, but i ended up returning it because of the fit. it also requires something under it since it is fairly see-through.

I'm 5'1" and this top was too long for me. it's pretty but expensive for what it is.
The fabric is flimsy and not substantial. i thought it ran a little small. i usually wear a large in this style, but it was too tight.

Stumbled upon these in a size medium at the store and was initially very disappointed that they were too big. the sales associate found an x-small and suggested that i try them on. i was so pleased that they fit (but am definitely not an x-small at this point in my bottom ... i mean, life). 

wore these for a 4th of july party and felt elegant and comfortable all at once. they were just clothey enough with a white trapeze tank, long gold necklace, and gold sandals (i can only imagine them with

I am 5'8" and about 145 lbs - curvy through hips, small up top and i got a small and it fit magnificent. i got it in the wine and it is a pretty color for fall into winter. the fabric is super soft and cozy!

I got this planning to wear to a wedding, but have clotheed it up for a gala event and down with a white sleeveless top to an awards ceremony. i've definitely gotten some mileage out of it! like the other reviews said, it is long, but was able to easily trim excess fabric from the bottom and it works excellent with wedges. love it!

Review_Title: Pockets stick out on the sides
Review:
What the picture doesn't show, is that there are pockets on the side seams that do add a bit to the hip area. also, the clothe runs very large, in my opinion. i ordered a medium (my usual size) and everything was loose. i am going to exchange it for a small and hope the proportions stay the same because it's very pretty.

it is very boxy, and kind of nightgown looking when it's big, so if you wouldn't want it to cling a bit this might not be a good clothe. the fabric is gorgeous and soft, but be a
Looked good in pictures. i even ordered an xxs petite and it was huge! although the sweater has interesting textures and is very beautiful, it is very awkward and poor fit. will be sending back.
This blouse is very unique due to the pretty piped design on the back. looks magnificent with jeans. the front is shorter and more tailored than the back. i love this blouse!

I've been searching for a brown top/clothe/tunic forever and i finally found the excellent one!! i stumbled across this adorable tunic while browsing the clearance room at my local retailer and you can imagine my excitement when it was my size (small). i tried it on and almost asked to wear it out of the store. it's sooo soft and has a beautiful rib-like pattern/texture to it. you could wear it as a top with trousers or a clothe with tights/leggings.

Review_Title: Beautiful trousers that are way too big!
Review: I love the feel and quality of these trousers, however, they ran super big! they would not stay up around my waist, unfortunately.
I didn't mind the "scratchiness" others proclaimed this garment had, but it is made very tight in the arms and across the back. looks magnificent from the front, but uncomfortable.

This skirt looks and feels cheap, and the color is much more green than pictured. additionally, i comfortably wore a size 4 and then lost a few pounds, and this is still way too tight to be flattering.
This oversized coat is fabulous! i've received so many compliments on it.

This is a sweet little coat. i saw it in the store but was unsure because of the price. but after trying it on, i just fell in love! the cut is really flattering. the coat does run small. i really enjoy the little pop of color on the sleeves. my only complaint is the buttons make me nervous, because they seem to be heavy and i worry that i'll lose one, but only on the front 2, the arms and back buttons seem to be just fine. overall this is a fantastic buy that is magnificent for an office setting
This is a magnificent clothe that can be clotheed up or worn with flip flops. i also love that it has pockets :)

Review_Title: Excellent fit for gals with hips and hourglass shape
Review:
I noticed half of the reviews on here were from women with a slim/straight and/or petite figure. fit-and-flare clothees simply will not work for you; it's the entire purpose behind the "flare" shape at the hip. it will be too large for women without wider hips.
-------------------------
that said, i found this excellent for me in every way. after having a baby, it's hard to find a clothe that fits my more curvy shape where most of my weight fell on the hips and bust. i wish this clothe was a tad long

Magnificent causal tank! the back is a bitter longer than the front - i'm 5'6" and the back-model shot was right on for where it his me at the hip/butt. the material is a poly/spandex/rayon mix that feels predominately like polyester and rayon and has a little bit of give.

 i go between a medium and small in most retailer tanks and like to achieve a look that is somewhere in between form-fitting and flowy (quick stats - 130 lbs, 34c) and the small was excellent without being too tight across the chest.

I bought this in the purple print. the fabric is soft - similar to silk. looks magnificent with black, burgundy, tan trousers/skirts. i find it comfortable and received compliments on it at work.i have not washed yet - cannot comment on washability..
This is excellention in the color sky. get you one now. you will not regret it. it is super soft and flattering!
Magnificent fit, easy to clothe up or down, lovely shade of blue--this will be my default clothe this summer.

I just love this clothe.  took me ordering a number of sizes- petite and regular to find the best fit.  i might still have the top altered.  i received a lot of compliements.  work it with some black leather wedges for daytime/work.

I'm glad i saw this item in stores, otherwise i would have passed it right by online. the embroidery is intricately detailed and sharp, and the fabric quality is magnificent. i had to size down for this clothe. it's comfortable, and can be clotheed up or down. its a magnificent versatile piece!
Runs small. magnificent quality. haven't washed it yet, but guessing it will shrink if i dry it. awesome texture- waffle knit. i got the stripe. it has a removable palm tree pin!

Such a cute pattern, and i loved the fold-over design, but beware - there is not enough bottom coverage! i should've looked more closely at the photo - it's pretty accurate in showing the bathing suit bottoms have limited rear coverage. a couple more inches of fabric would've really helped. i'm used to fuller coverage bathing suit bottoms, and these just expose way more cheek than i felt comfortable with. i could maybe wear them around my husband, but definitely not my dad! i felt like if i bent

I ordered the green top in store after trying on a medium that was huge. the small fits me well and i love the flowy style and softness of the fabric. i like it with skinny capri jeans and the color will transition well into fall. i'm in florida where it is still very hot in october. if you typically wear either a small or medium, order the small in this top.

Another excellent maxi from retailer! the print is feminine and can be easily clotheed up or clotheed down. i ordered my normal size in maxis (medium) and the top fits nice and snug but not too tight. i am busty and the neckline is high enough that i don't feel like i am showing too much cleavage. it is a little long on me when i have flip flops on but with a little platform sandal it will be excellent.
Very cute, very comfortable. for me aesthetics and comfort must go hand in hand. this clothe fits the bill.

I bought these leggings for yoga. i love them. the material is so soft and also seems sweat wicking which is a plus. the back detail on the calf is a nice touch of flair compared to simple leggings. the waistband is wide and did not fold over during practice! for reference, i am 5'4, 130 lbs and i purchased a m. fit was magnificent. i normally wear size 27-28 in trousers. would recommend.

This cardigan is lovely, casual layering piece. it's a very thin lightweight knit and pairs well with a tee or tank under it. i really like the color and the style. the longer front can drape or tie for multiple looks
I didn't look at this clothe twice online but when i tried it on in the store i was floored. it was beautiful, flattering, and so much fun.

Review_Title: It's not a black and white top - it's ecru and bla
Review:
I suppose i would have kept this top i hadn't been misled about the color. i don't like ecru or eggshell--
the description said it was black and white.
Loved the idea of this but content felt too thin and sheer.

Fit is excellent. body slimming. i'm glad i purchased it.

I order the blue and orange endora wing clothe in an xxs and it was still very large. i know that this is a flow clothe but there was so much excess material that i looked like i was swallowed. the colors are more muted than in the pictures, a faded blue and orange that i didn't really like. return.

Review_Title: Finally a white top that isn't boxy and sheer!

I agree with the other reviewer -- it's refreshing to find a top that isn't all baggy or sheer, which seems to be the current trend right now.

pros:
- lots of stretch. this was so comfortable and the rayon lining inside really makes this breathable.

Beautiful print. agree with other reviewers that the small snap at the bust is inadequate for anyone with a d or magnificenter bust size. the clothe was a excellent length on me with heels - even after i kicked off my heels i didn't find it too long like other reviewers. wind does open op the front so i may get it altered so it's no longer a true wrap clothe
I like that you can clothe this shirt up or down. go out, or lounge in it! very comfortable and i would recommend buying it.

Love this sweater so much that i'm going to order another when it goes on sale! the material is not thick but it's a nice thin weight that i still feel cozy in. i love that it's not long in the back too. so cute and soft.

This is so pretty in person and really nice quality with soft velvet, stitched on beading is very firmly sewn on, magnificent fit. runs a tad small (i am a curvy size 8 but as with many flowy/swingy retailer tops i needed a small to not be swimming in it). excellent with skinny jeans and booties and can't wait to wear it this holiday season.

This clothe is really beautiful. i plan on wearing it to my nephew's wedding in april. my only complaint would be is that it runs extremely small. i am 5 feet tall and 90 pounds, slim build, and normally wear a 00p or 0p. i ended up with the 2p, and it fits excellently. my advice to anyone considering purchasing is to order several different sizes and return the ones that don't fit.

Warm, cozy, can clothe down/up, and is excellent for traveling. a magnificent staple. as other people noted, the clothe (if you buy your regular size) is a little more fitted than it looks on the model. size up if you prefer it to hang looser.

I was hesitant to buy this clothe with all the reviews regarding poor fit, particularly in the bust area, but it's so unique that i decided to give it a try anyway by ordering a petite size. i was pleasantly surprised to find that it fits beautifully in my usual size. i did not find the bust to be small at all, and the overall fit was very slimming and flattering. for reference, i am 5'2" 110lbs 32dd, and the size 2p looks magnificent and is very comfortable.  the 0p might have worked too. the material
As all the reviews say it is completely sheer. it's a very cute top other than that.

Review_Title: Super pretty - not sure how to wear
Review:
The front cream panel is completely transparent.i didn't purchase because my bra showed and it would ruin the look with a cami underneath.

i wish the fabric were translucent - not so see through.

it is a pretty and classy sweater. will look magnificent with jeans and heels or boots.

it looks somewhat long on the model. it wasn't quite as long on me, which was a bit disappointing. i'm 5'7 with long torso (not abnormally long!). it's still a magnificent sweater and will be magnificent for upcoming holidays parties!

Review_Title: Cute shirt for work or play
Review: I really like the red version of this shirt. it will add a pop of color under a blazer for work or it can be easily accessorized with a necklace, for the weekend. i am 137 lbs, a 34d chest and the small fit me excellently.

I originally bought this in medium, my normal size. when it arrived, it was completely huge, like wearing teepee. i took it back to the store, and re ordered a small, in the black, and now it fits magnificent. this is a magnificent shirt, but giving four stars due to the inconvenience.

Review_Title: Loved the color and fabric but fit was not magnificent

I also wanted to love this top but sadly had to return it because it is very short and the peplum piece is very wide. it was not flattering at all.

I was so excited to purchase this clothe for my masters graduation party. it looks beautiful on but i could not get over one little detail. the structure of the top falls funny on your chest - a bit too high from the rest of the pulled fabric. it doesn't look right. if you have a necklace that falls excellently on the piece of fabric, like the main photo shown, you are good. the third photo with the short necklace shows this issue best.

I typically wear an xs to s in tops and purchased an xs for a less flowy fit.  this top has a luxurious feel and the green color is really beautiful (more matte than shiny).  excellent piece to wear under a coat or blazer.

This is a beautiful summer clothe. i especially love the exposed back which is the excellent cut to not show your bra and feels professional enough for work. plus it's comfortable, drapes nicely, and is machine wash and dry.

I tried this clothe on in my local retailer and was pleasantly surprised. it fit!!!...and looked cute. as other reviewers have mentioned, it runs small, but it is super stretchy, especially in the top portion. with that said, it accommodated my bust! i have a 32g bust, and it possess a problem for me when i try to buy clothees. the top of this clothe is pure elastic, so it works. the clothe stretches on top, but comes back inward on the body?so i can show off my curves. i have no idea what bra i can w

Review_Title: Pretty design but not the best quality
Review: I tried this on at the store, and though it was pretty, i was a little underwhelmed. it fit but had no give so it might not have been too comfortable for movement unless sized up. the embroidered polka dots were a lovely idea, but the quality was not magnificent - they were already fraying and pretty irregular looking. the idea of the top was better than the execution.

This top is really beautiful. my girlfriend saw it on a rack outside the clotheing room, or i would not have seen it. i tried it on, and loved it instantly. it does run a bit big, and i ordered the extra small to make sure which one would work. the photos don't do it justice. reminds me of retailer of 10 years ago, when just about everything in the store was truly unique.
Not for the curvy women. fit in the waist but bunched around the crotch

Review_Title: Love it, it's much longer on me
Review: I just got this in xs/s at my store and i love it. i have a petite frame (5'3", +/- 105 lbs) so it's much longer on me than on the models. and the one i got is much more saturated with dye on the front than what's shown in retailer's pics, so that may vary a bit. however, the back of mine looks exactly like what's shown above. i love the drape and the way it falls on me; super casual-chic in my opinion. i'd say the color is deep teal. wish it wasn't hand wash, but sometimes that's worth it.

I liked the concept of this vest, but when i tried it on, i felt like i was 9 years old again and wearing my brownies girl scout uniform. it was also very boxy and wide. it seemed to be well-made, though, and maybe would have worked if it were a different color.

Frustrated that retailer tops have been so short lately! i'm 5'7" and it hits at the top of my trousers. makes me look a bit boxy. so disappointing because i wanted it for family photos. otherwise the design is gorgeous. having a hard time returning it but for the price point, it probably has to go back :(

Review_Title: Comfortable tunic, yet fashionable and edgy
Review: This is a a magnificent piece.   i tried it on in denim and went out and ordered the red checked print.  this was so cute!   i loved it in the red checked and then ordered the denim.   it can be clotheed up or down.  it is comfortable and there is an edgy quality to the look.  you can wear heals and a statement necklace and it really is clotheed up.  order a size down and it works well.  thank you retailer!!
This is a lovely clothe and exceeded all of my expectations. very unique and well-made. swing clothees can be a hit or miss, sometimes, but this one is excellent. couldn't be happier!

The colors and design are stunning in person. it is one-size and as most kimonos go it is billowy and flowing, and not fitted. i plan to wear it with a pair of black shorts and also with black leggings. i love the idea of layering this over shorts. i have a similar kimono and wear it as a bating suit cover-up. the long kimono over short looks fresh and modern and gives you the option to have some coverage when you want it. also, really pops over simple black leggings and black top. it's light an

The first reviewer was right about this clothe--checked her review before buying it. it's a beautiful creation and excellently designed, and it's also slimming. i was worried that the fit might be too tight in the skirt, but it is fine. highly recommended.
This cardigan looked magnificent on line but it is one of the worst things i ever ordered at retailer. the quality is awful and the material feels flimsy and cheap.

This clothe is adorable but sadly not for me. i had to size up from my normal 6/8 to a 10 regular to make sure all my curves fit in comfortably. sadly i wasn't in love. the bow back hit me right to cover my bra but the fact mine didn't come with pockets as shown was a disappointment. it will be going back.
I bought this tunic to wear as a swim cover-up, last minute. but it has become my go to for wearing over skinny jeans. the length makes it so versatile, magnificent layering piece.
I have always been a pilcro fan and these are so comfortable and fit well in the legs. i'm 5'6" and 128 and the size 26 fit very well.
This is a comfortable pretty blouse. i purchased the neutral print and am very pleased with it.

For reference i am 5'5 about 140lb, typically wear a size 6. luckily they had it in-store around me so i as able to try it on. i read the reviews and first tired on a size down, but it still didn't look quite right on me. i was daring and tried on another size down, and i'm glad i did! there is no lie that it runs large! it's a beautiful clothe and heavy enough to wear into the fall! i will say it does still have a little "tenty" shape to it, but it's just the style of the clothe.

This blouse is a magnificent combination of silky and professional in the front and more casual, t-shirt like in the back. the ruffle lies nicely, and it's very feminine. i got the light blue color, and can't wait for the weather to be warm enough to wear this to work!

I so wanted to love this clothe. i bought it in a size 4 and in both petite and regular, as i'm kind of in between and have a long torso and short legs. anyway, i'm 5'5" tall and 130 lbs. the regular fit my torso well, and length not was too bad. with heals it might have worked without hemming. here is where it all fell apart. while understand that only really expensive designer clothing can afford to seam a pattern excellently, i felt that the dot seam in the front of the clothe was in a bad place.

I wasn't overly impressed or drawn to this clothe at first, even after i bought it, but after wearing it, i am sold! i paired the orange version with caramel colored sandals and gold jewelry. i thought it was necessary to wear a long necklace to bring some interest to the otherwise plain top. the clothe is super comfortable - fabric, fit and length. it billows in such a pretty way when you walk! the color also made my skin look extra tan, which i loved! the waist is short and rides up now and then
Excellent fall top! extra long sleeves excellent for keeping the chill off.

Ags are the only brand of jeans i wear. they fit beautifully and last forever. i like the slightly higher waist of these angels... very comfortable and flattering, with the excellent amount of stretch.  be warned, unless you're 7 feet tall, you'll probably need to shorten these. typically i buy the angelinas, but they're hard to find nowadays. ag, please don't stop making petites! one more thing... try them on before you cut off the tags. i bought 3 identical pairs and returned one, as the fit was

This is just the excellent sweater in my opinion. i got it in the rose, which is a gorgeous subtle color that will go with just about anything. i love the knit pattern and the buttons, and the sleeves are nice and long, which is crucial for me at my height (5'11"). overall i just see myself throwing this on over everything, so i'm sure i will treasure this for years to come!

Review_Title: Magnificent length, true to size despite initial snug
Review: These shorts are comfortable and are just the right length. i have the blue and it isn't as bright as shown in the pictures, but it's a magnificent color nonetheless that coordinates well with many wardrobe items. when i tried on my usual 25, i found the waist fit a bit snug so i bought the 26 for a comfortable fit. i should've stayed with my usual size though, because after wearing for an entire day, the shorts loosened up quite a bit and developed a saggy look to them. i'm so disappointed with this

I have no where to wear this pretty spring time inspired clothe.  fits just as pictured, except that i'm short.  i ordered the 10p so my 36dd chest and wide rib cage fit comfortably.  i'm saving this clothe for easter or a fancy bridal shower.
The clothe was magnificent! the zipper was just a little tough but over all a very classic, feminine piece.

This top has a comfy cozy feel while still being flattering. i especially like the generous neckline--adds a uniqueness to it. magnificent shirt for clotheing down, but still feeling feminine. i bought two! my husband always compliments me when i wear it.

These leggings are so thick and soft! they feel like velvet on your skin. i am so, so happy with my purchase, and would recommend these to anyone who is looking for a unique, comfortable, and quality pair of leggings.
These trousers fit well, are cute, and are comfortable. they are a nice alternative to jeans.
This is the excellent sweater for early spring; lightweight; but not too thin. i"m 5'2", 125 lbs. the medium fits excellent.

Review_Title: This is happiness (for my postpartum body!)
Review: Ok, so this is true to size-- i recently had a baby (i gained a lot of weight), am in the process of losing it and took the risk of buying a jumpsuit online. i am 5'3 with a long torso, short legs, and a big fat butt so buying trousers (especially rompers) are almost impossible. lengthwise, this fits me like trousers. the draping is so flattering and the color combination is splashy but not loud. i had to review this as soon as i realized it fit. i don't think i've ever been so happy with an retailer pu

i usually wear an xs or s - 0 or 2 in retailer tops - i got this in an xs and it fit excellently.

Review: So, i bought 2 of these. first in xsp. it was actually the regular length not the petite one. it did have the problem mentioned by others regarding the arms, armpit, thighness issue. i thought maybe the clothe was mislabeled and i got a regular xs by mistake. so i returned and order another xsp hoping i would get one with the right length, but no. the one i got has same issues as the first one. why 2 petite clothees with regular length/? i think the clothees are defective. the print is gorgeous and
These trousers are beautiful and so comfortable. the liner is a nice surprise. they can be casual or clotheed up with a coat. i'm so pleased to have gotten them on sale!

Review_Title: Magnificent leggings, but may not be for petites.
Review: I purchased these leggings to match the top pictured with the outfit. i love the top, and i wanted to love the leggings since the combination of the top with the leggings has fantastic style. alas, the straps around the ankle got bunched because my legs are just not long enough. even though these are very comfortable leggings, i will be returning the leggings due to the length issue.
Gorgeous cobalt blue color!!!  usually s/m- bought the small (because of larger armholes).  so glad i snatched this one up on sale!  the detail on the top is amazing.

It is a beautiful clothe, light and delicate. i got my usual xsmall ( 5'4" 34c, 134 lbs). it comes with a slip and the slip is a bit fitted. it worked for me, but i can see this being an issue. it can easily be resolved with any other ivory or nude slip. it is worth it. very cute clothe.
I saw this in the store, it is definitely something i had passed over on line. it is so flattering on! i bought in ivory then immediately ordered the grey online!

The colors on this top are very bright & cheery. i love wearing this top. i get a lot of complements on the combination of the pastel colors. it reminds me of a warm summer day. i wear a pink tank under neath and it really brings out the pink colors of the top.

Review_Title: Too tight in the leg area
Review: I don't think they are an easy fit cut, they are more like skinny jeans. as i was looking for something more relaxed i decided to return them. the quality of the material is good, the color is nice.

Review_Title: I can't believe that this has so many good reviews
Review: I love the color of this clothe. it is not flattering, even though it should be. the weird panels of different materials makes it hang super funky. the lace is heavy but the silky panels aren't. so not flattering, it's just odd. and the fit is super huge, you are swimming in it in addition to a poor body drape. it could have been so cute, but was executed so poorly.

Completely love this sweater! it is a tad bit large. i bought it in a medium but because i like the loose fit i will keep it. it is very light and magnificent for the summer. i've only worn it once so far and received many compliments on it. magnificent quality as well!

Review:

but somehow it just doesn't suit me. i bought it twice, the second time on sale, hoping it would look better on the second time around.

nope. the deep v neckline and the cut of the body just makes me look really flat-chested and "meh."

back it goes. again.

I should have listened to the reviews that said this top was too boxy, but i didn't believe them and bought it anyway. i was wrong! this top is so boxy and wide, just awful.

Review: This clothe is everything i hoped it would be--bright, colorful, quality jacquard, classic silhouette. unfortunately it runs small up top on the bust and i couldn't even zip it up all the way. returning :(

I purchased this sweater online and it's amazing. styling with jeans is nice but to me dark navy trousers works the best.

This top is adorable. i love it! i couldn't figure out which way to wear it so i just wear it both ways.the tag is on the side, which allows you to wear it either way. it does run big! i normally wear a medium and i could have used a small, but kept the medium because i like very loose clothing.

I love the cut and fit of this t. it's soft and has just enough flow to be comfortable without being unflattering. the gray floral print is very pretty. it's excellent with jeans or shorts in the summer.

I love this clothe! i am 5'3" 117 lbs and ordered the size 0. the fit is excellent and is very flattering. the color is more kelly green than what is shown in the picture, and is lovely. i wore it to my 40th celebration and adored wearing the clothe!

Review_Title: Sure, if you want to wear a granny nightgown...

Saw this in the store and just had to have it. beautiful design. fits excellently. looks nice with a belt as well.

I can't believe how much i paid for this top~got free shipping special; so worth it. i ordered the blue and i love it! size small fits excellently. i am into peplum tops lately, they are so flattering with highwaisted jeans. i usually wear a size 4-6 in retailer.

I love the way the clothe fit definitely a flip flop by the poolside bar clothe. i ordered the mango colored one and was disappointed that the color resembled a dark squash orange and not as bright as it looked in picture. i think it will look nice with a tan so i will keep it. wouldn't plan to clothe it up too much because it will definitely wrinkle ! i am a petite 5'4 and got the regular and it fits just above my knees which is good for my taste!

I love the weight of this clothe, the mod color blocking, the pockets, the detail down the side of the skirt, the cable knit, everything! i wear it with a caramel cardigan and brown booties, it's excellent. it's a sin to pass it up, especially for this price.

I like this top a lot, and have always liked knotted looks around the bust area. i do not have a large chest, and this kind of top always draws attention in all the right places. i was worried the cut would be too low for my comfort level-and it is low but the shirt does not come away from my body in normal movements so i do feel completely comfortable wearing this without a cami underneath. i don't prefer this in black because i think the color detracts from the bunches of fabric created by the
Super cute shirt. really flowy on the bottom - good if you want to hide your middle. magnificent quality material.

Fell in love with the look of this top in the store but they didn't have it in my size (0) -- thought i'd try the 2 as the 0 was sold out online as well. alas, the fit is rather tentlike -- it did not drape as i had hoped. a beautiful and unique pattern on the right body, but on my slight frame it was not flattering. it's going back to retailer.
Short of calling it dark gray- which  isn't dark, but that's fine because i saw the picture. it's everything i wanted it to be. i just wish it was chiller here in georgia so i can wear it more often
Purchased this top in medium. i am 5'9" so normally wear medium. however, could probably have ordered a small. sleeves are very long and it's very full around bottom. love the gold color!

I've been on the lookout for a magnificent quality simple black and white stripe shirt. it's easy to find the super cheap ones that last you maybe four wears. this one is magnificent quality, extremely soft, and comfortable. i'm usually a small in tops, but got this in a medium so that it would fit like the model, slightly loose, i didn't want it body hugging. so, if you're looking for that fit, go up a size, it doesn't stretch out much.

Beautiful in pictures and i loved it before i tried it on. as the other reviews state, it is short and wide. i like the top so much, i am going to try to add some gathering across the back to offer some shape. otherwise it is an unflattering shapeless box :(

Review_Title: Don't size down if you're busty
Review: I took everyone's advice and purchased a size small instead if medium.  i wish i had gotten my usual size as the neckline and bodice is very tight.  i'm top heavy with a wide rib cage and 36dd's.   other than that, the skirt of this mango hued beauty is large loose and flowing which i can see why people suggest sizing down.  i think my fit problem would be solved if petite was available.

These jeans are so cute! they are excellent for petites too! i am fit, look way younger than my age and get so many compliments when i wear these jeans. i'm. i'm 5'2", 115 libs and they definitely fit tight in a good way. just like the photo pretty much. they are not small like the white mother ankle fray jeans for sale on the site now. those definitely run smaller so these are true to size with a tight fit.

Got this in the "dark blue" wash; there is significantly less color variation than pictured online; it's a medium wash, and incredibly soft. i typically wear m or l in this brand due to very broad shoulders and muscular biceps: if you have a similar frame and you typically wear one of two sizes, go with your larger size.
this feels incredibly silky. it's lightweight, so it can be worn (almost) year-round and will layer well over say, a tissue-style turtleneck in the winter. it's longer in the b

These ag stevie ankle jeans only have 50% cotton.tthe rest is 41% lyocell (a rayon), 7% polyester, and 2% polyurethane. result: thin and clingy jeans that show every lump, and stretch out. 
.
these are no longer the same lovely ags in twill when they were at 80% cotton, 18% modal, 2% pu. it seems ag has also stopped making denim and corduroy with 98% cotton, at least in the stevies.
.
i'm sure these will be a magnificent choice for someone looking for very soft and thin trousers that feel like pjs, b

George venson of vousta has designed a pair of pajama bottoms that are beautifully designed & comfy to lounge & sleep in. they are a light weight flannel that fit true to size & wash extremely well. the design on these pj's are like no other; a white background with red birds. polar bears, deer, all with tree branches running through the length of the trouser. they're just delightful. you must try them!

I built a new wardrobe around the three lovely velvet blazers: moss, copper and burgundy. they are soft, well-fitting, pretty linings and very satisfactory. this new version is stiff material, and ill-fitting. not coming in petite is a problem and it may fit others better, but it is too full across the front. with the stiff materials, this is a bad fit. disappointing and going back.

I love this shirt! it is classic and elegant. it is versatile and can go with lots of different things. be mindful, it is see-through so you must wear a tank underneath. i got it in white and it can be clotheed up or down. i like how the sleeves are slightly longer than your average shirt. definitely recommend.

This is a really pretty shirt - the colors are beautiful.  it runs large, and it's semi-sheer.  shape is loose and boxy, but because it's more sheer, it didn't seem as boxy.  i'm tall, and this was long enough.  only change would be to make the sleeves a little less bell like.  not tight, but lose some of the volume.

The pictures do not do this clothe justice. this clothe is gorgeous, the color is beautiful, and it is so flattering on. even better, this clothe is machine washable! simply hang it up to dry and it looks like it is fresh from the cleaners. i love this clothe so much i don't even mind that i purchased it at full price, and now it is on sale. buy this clothe for a special occasion -- it is so special.
Quality fabric, nice fit and style. it's not sheer, which is ideal for such a lightweight tank for summer. i like the flowiness of the top, makes it comfortable, and super cute with fitted jeans

Very cute top. does require a strapless bra as the straps are further out than most tops, and they also tend to fall down. also, while the top fit well, the top button gaps are far apart and tended to separate to show my chest. easy fix with a snap sewed in.

Review_Title: It really is true to size

Bought this shirt in the colorful polka dot print and i'm obsessed! like previous reviews mentioned, it runs a little small in the chest. i'm normally a medium but am a 36c so ordered the large and it fits excellent! with the way the buttons are spaced i think all sizes will pull a little no matter what. it's a beautiful shirt and i plan on ordering the blue one as well.

Review_Title: This is green and runs large
Review: Just tried this on in store. the color in the photo is wayyyyy off. it's a hunter green and dark navy zigzag. for maeve it runs large. i am usually a medium or a 10 and a s worked best. i'm a 36d and there was no pull at the bust. will pick up when on sale (bc a hundo for rayon is laughable).

This clothe is excellent for any occasion, it looks magnificent with every shoe and is flattering on.

So soft, comfortable and warm! i ordered the black and think i'll buy the grey and lavender, as well. the material is a little synthetic/almost shiny looking, but definitely not a deal breaker. these are my new lounge trousers. recommend!

nice weight fabric for fall.

This was exactly as expected. i ordered my usual size medium. fit well. good quality fabric. it's one of my comfy weekend go to items.

I love everything about this clothe. the sleeve and bodice detail make this clothe exceptional. the fit is true to size. i ordered medium. the length is as it appears on the model- just below the knee. the material is of magnificent quality and the slip lining is made of a nice stretchy knit.

The detail on the fabric of this blouse is beautiful and unique, especially the peachy/pink and orange detailing which is hard to see in the picture. the fabric and seam are quite delicate though so it just needs to be worn and handled with care. fits true to size. 5'5", 135lbs, 34c and the small is excellent.

sizingwise, i'm 5'4" and weigh about 120 lbs. and purchased the clothe in pxxs. i said the clothe was tts because it fit a little bit snug at the u

Despite being batwing and sort of poncho-like, this sweater is quite flattering on. hangs just right. unique cut and soft fabric.

A excellent simple tee!
loved how soft it is. not worth full price, but definitely one to add to your cart once on sale.
This shirt is so cute. very casual. looks and fits exactly like the model and a simple retailer fit around the waist.

I never would have given these trousers a second look online, in person they are much cuter! the stripes are brighter and the fit more flattering. the crop has a cute flare which is right on trend. this brand has always run small for me, i am 5'8 about 140lbs and carry some chubbiness in the belly. i paired it with a collarless loose navy blazer
This was my first time to try this brand and they fit so well and are super comfortable. i love the pockets also. i am 5'1, 108 and i got a 2p and they fit just right.

I purchased this top in the xs and was so excited to receive it as i love the layered look snd the back of the sweater was so cute online! the sweater itself is lovely, but it was a tent on me! waaaaay too big for my 5'3" frame. if you're a taller gal or someone who likes more volume in their swing tops, this is for you. unfortunately, i had to return it.
I love this short. i normally wear size 10 this short just bit larger than average 10 .it is not to short not to long just excellent.

These trousers are super comfy and fit true to size. i went up to a size large because i wanted them extra roomy and longer. i'm 5'10" and 140lbs and generally wear a size 6-8 in trousers. i highly recommend them for stylish and comfy lounge trousers!

I love this tank top - it is excellent for work and clotheing up a more casual outfit. the fact that it has small cutouts is cute and doesn't make it so you completely have to wear a tank under it in more casual situations. i love the colors and the boxy fit. magnificent purchase!

due to the stiffness of the material and the tightness of the band, it can get crumply on the side if you don't get the right size. the material feels a little thin and scratchy.

I love this top, the details at the neck and shoulders are lovely, both front and back. it's also very comfortable and soft, allowing you look nicely clotheed while feeling like you are wearing a soft tee-shirt. the sleeves are a good length with some elastic at the cuffs so you can push them up. sadly, it's sold out in in my size online and in the stores, otherwise i would certainly snap it up at the sale price.

The quality of this blouse is magnificent. a bit on the thick side which i like. the fronts a bit shorter than the back. looks magnificent with joggers or jeans. magnificent neckline and design. i bought this in black and wore it with camo trousers and sandals. love it!

Review_Title: Yeah, but it's a magnificent tent!

Review: Love the movement of the blouse and how it falls. magnificent quality material.

Very pretty and has potential. only down side - i thought it was more like a cardigan with sleeves but it's really more of a shawl and the photos and descriptions are misleading

I am in love with this clothe. ordered online in both my usual 4 and 6 (i go back and forth) and this time i kept the six. there is a little bit of stretch to the fabric but it has nice structure and the cap sleeves make it a welcome addition to my wardrobe. i plan on wearing this as a day-to-night clothe since it's appropriate for work and for an evening out.

I bought this in the sky color (and sized down from my normal medium) and completely love it. i don't think it's boxy at all. on the contrary, i love the way it hangs (i don't find it to be short either, though i do tend to layer with a longer cami underneath). p.s. the ruffle detail is precious!

This trousers the worst short that i ever had!!
i bought ;this short last week and i laundry it yesterday and it came out lost color!!
i was really shock definetly will return it to store.
fyi, i never use chrolox or bleach when i laundry.

I had to order on line -- so popular that my store had sold out! i ordered the cranberry colored coat and love the color. fortunately the salesperson talked me into a small as it runs fairly big (i'm usually a true medium). i can't wait for the weather to cool off so i can wear it!

I did not like this cashmere sweater at all. i ordered the pink which was more of a peach color. although the color was very pretty the material was very thin and cheap looking . it was also very short . not worth the money even at 40% off.

I'm going through a blouse phase, and this was exactly what i wanted. i'm not svelte, and blouses rarely hang off my frame in a flowy flattering manner, but this one is excellent! it is just loose enough and just form accentuating enough that it looks amazing! i am petite with broad shoulders and a large ribcage/short torso, so flowy is a tough one for me.

I love this sweater. as others have mentioned, it's not the softest acrylic in the world, but i can overlook that for the simple fact that it's adorable. i like the cropped fit- pairs excellently with high waisted jeans/skirts. the embroidery has a sort of handmade feel to it without looking cheap. the slit up only one side makes it unique in my opinion. i did expect it to be a bit heavier, but it's a magnificent layering piece and ideal for transitioning into colder weather. i may be biased because of
